As we close in on the Primary Election, Team Steiner has been ramping up our outreach and activities in the field in the North State. I wanted to highlight a few stops we made, and talk a bit about the type of campaign we're running.

We recently stopped by Gold Nugget Days in Paradise. Back in 1859, a 54-pound nugget was discovered in Paradise and this event is about celebrating Paradise's rich history. It was great meeting voters and talking about my campaign alongside friends with Paradise Ridge Democrats.

We also had the chance to attend the Annual Earth Day fair at the Redding Ranchería. I spoke to voters about environmental issue and much more. It was encouraging to see that folks were so keyed in on my race and the stakes of ousting LaMalfa.

|
Biden has abandoned all sense of security at our southern border. He’s putting our nation at risk.

Just last week, it was revealed that 23 individuals on the terror watchlist were apprehended at our southern border - how many got away?

In March we had a 20-year record high in border encounters.

And amid this chaos - Joe Biden, the man who is supposedly sworn to protect and defend our Constitution, was planning to end Title 42.

On day one he opened our southern border to the cartels, criminals, drug/human traffickers, and terrorists.

Joe Biden’s actions have made our nation less safe. He created a crisis and is actively working to make it worse.

How much more fentanyl has to flood our streets?
How many more suspected terrorists need to enter our nation?

What will it take for this incompetent President to make the safety and security of American communities a priority?

Each time I have gone to the border, Border Patrol agents have expressed how miserable and impossible Joe Biden has made their job. They are getting crushed, and the White House is to blame.

Joe Biden, Kamala Harris, Nancy Pelosi - they do not care. They are sitting back and watching this happen, hoping each new illegal immigrant is a democratic vote to secure their reign of power.

We cannot let them get away with this. We cannot allow Joe Biden to ruin this nation in his pursuit of radical liberal power.

Elections have consequences. Joe Biden has been a disaster and now we only have one option to try and undo the damage he has caused in one short year.

We need to take back the House and the Senate in November. If we don’t our nation will continue to suffer.

Best,
Chris Jacobs

Why did the FBI bust down my door, point guns at me and my wife, and separate us?

Joe Biden's FBI is on a witch hunt to incarcerate political protestors and anyone who believes in election integrity. **Allow me to tell you my full story and why it has inspired me to run for Lt. Governor of my state.**

_My wife and I attended the rally, but never entered the Capitol_. Contrary to what the Fake News media machine is reporting, the so-called "insurrection" was a peaceful protest composed of a million patriotic Americans.

I returned home to Alaska, and that's when all hell broke loose.

**The FBI broke into my house demanding to know, "Where is Nancy Pelosi's laptop?!". **

These were not simply kind police officers. These federal agents were armed with weapons a SWAT team uses to fight street gangs or takedown drug dealers.

They separated my wife and I and began interrogating us, and refused to show us a search warrant.

I told them our story but they did not listen. They preferred to use shock and awe against us.

**Eventually, they let us go but felt it necessary to take my pocket Constitution as "evidence" for supposedly stealing Nancy Pelosi's laptop or illegally entering the Capitol building (we did neither). **

Friend, Democrats are stealing our elections, taking political prisoners, and shredding the U.S. Constitution.

These events have inspired me to run for Lt. Governor of Alaska. Along with my running mate, Christopher Kurka who is running for Governor, we have united together to restore election integrity in Alaska, FIGHT BACK against the radical left, and fight for President Trump's legacy.

My state has become THE battleground state for the Election Integrity movement in our country. My job as Lieutenant Governor will be to oversee fair and honest elections.

I believe we must fight for Election Integrity and lead by example by enacting change in the states. Joe Biden sure as hell won't do it.

Growing up, I didn't think I would become the second woman in American history to be elected both Governor and Senator.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44600608/342318002/-376037004?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3405-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZTU1NjBiMS0yYWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gqbMc07zwj0m4qY8DkQWk_I5ZG7QDorI1XsppAkq3HQ=)
My dad was a WWII veteran who survived the Battle of the Bulge. He used to look over the corner of his newspaper at the breakfast table and ask my siblings and me, “What are you doing for freedom today?”
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44600611/342318003/-376037004?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3405-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZTU1NjBiMS0yYWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gqbMc07zwj0m4qY8DkQWk_I5ZG7QDorI1XsppAkq3HQ=)
That's a big question for three kids trying to finish their cereal, but it's one I make a point to answer every day. I first got my start in public service as an advocate, helping to ensure that children like my son Ben, who has cerebral palsy, would be fully included in their communities and have the same opportunities that all parents want for their children.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44600612/342318008/-376037004?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3405-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZTU1NjBiMS0yYWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gqbMc07zwj0m4qY8DkQWk_I5ZG7QDorI1XsppAkq3HQ=)
In the Senate, I was one of the deciding votes to save the Affordable Care Act in 2017. If it weren't for 1,017 votes in New Hampshire in 2016, a Republican would have been in my seat, and millions of Americans would have lost their health care coverage.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44600614/342318009/-376037004?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3405-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZTU1NjBiMS0yYWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gqbMc07zwj0m4qY8DkQWk_I5ZG7QDorI1XsppAkq3HQ=)
It is the honor of my lifetime to represent Granite Staters, and I’m not done fighting for New Hampshire. From lowering the cost of prescription drugs to ending Big Oil’s billions in tax breaks, I'll continue working to ensure that all Americans, regardless of personal circumstances, have the opportunity to succeed.
But here's the deal: **Mitch McConnell only has to flip one seat to take back the Senate, and I'm at the top of his list.** That's why GOP groups have spent more against me than any other Senate Democrat ($7.8 million and counting).
I hate asking for money, but I really need your help to win this November. [**If you can, please split $5 or as much as you're comfortable with between me and Kirsten Gillibrand before our critical end of month deadline.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44600616/342318011/-376037004?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3405-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZTU1NjBiMS0yYWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gqbMc07zwj0m4qY8DkQWk_I5ZG7QDorI1XsppAkq3HQ=)
I really appreciate it!
With every good wish,
Maggie Hassan

subject: Counter false history and anti-American teaching
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWAux80HN7

There is a powerful movement in our culture to teach young
Americans that our nation's history is oppressive and shameful.
Sometimes, this effort...
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWAux80HN7

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Fellow
American,

There is
a powerful movement in our culture to teach young Americans that
our nation's history is oppressive and shameful.

Sometimes, this effort goes under the name "critical race
theory." Other times, activists advance these ideas through works
like The New York Times' "1619 Project."

This
radical movement pushes a narrative that slavery, not freedom, is
the defining characteristic of American history. They teach our
children that we should replace equal individual rights with the
idea of unequal rights based on group identity.

Hillsdale
College is committed to countering this destructive ideology.
That's why we have produced a new, free online course titled
"Civil Rights in American History." And right now, it is
available in a special, limited DVD box set.

When you
take this course, you'll learn about:

How
our Founding Founders understood equality, natural rights, and
civil rights.
The
quest for justice in America through the Civil War, during
Reconstruction, and in the 20th century.
The
danger posed to freedom and civil rights today by identity
politics.

You can
help promote "Civil Rights in American History" and receive your
very own DVD box set of this timely and important new course by
giving a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more today.

As we do
all of our work, we produce free online courses while refusing to
accept any government funding. We don't even receive indirect
funding in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

At
Hillsdale, we rely entirely on the support of private citizens
like you who agree with our mission on behalf of liberty.

Please
help promote Hillsdale's free online courses and other
educational outreach efforts during this critical time by making
your best gift today. And don't forget. When you give $100 or
more, you'll receive your very own DVD box set of "Civil Rights
in American History."

You can
make your tax-deductible donation using the secure link below:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-civil-rights-in-american-history-dvd

But
please don't wait. There are only a limited number of "Civil
Rights in American History" DVD box sets available, so reserve
your copy before they're gone.

Thank you
for partnering with Hillsdale in its educational mission on
behalf of liberty.

Best
regards,

Kyle
Murnen, '09
Director
of Online Learning
Hillsdale
College

| | Friends

We all want to protect our children and their education. That works best when parents and teachers work together and listen to each other. It doesn't work when politicians use kids as political pawns to divide us from one another.

**But that’s exactly what my opponent, Tom Kean Jr, did when he went on Fox News and falsely accused elementary school teachers in his home town of preparing to teach "exposure to pornography" to 2nd graders.**

Instead of calming things down as any responsible leader would do, he chose again to stir up anger, mistrust, and fear in hopes he can ride it to power.

He’s hitched his wagon to the most extreme wing in his party -- the same faction, exploiting the same fears, that is trying to ban math books, to censor references to the Holocaust, and erase discussion of the existence of LGBTQ Americans in schools across the country.

**Kean and I agree on one thing: parents should have a voice in their kids' education. That's why I hold public town halls and go to schools to hear the broad range of issues parents, teachers, and students are actually concerned about, which he has done exactly zero times. **

In these public forums, I hear from many parents — liberal and conservative — concerned about learning loss from school closures, about mental health & the real problem of youth suicides in our communities. Most parents are more interested in protecting their kids from guns than from books.

And the overwhelming majority of New Jersey parents know that we have some of the best public schools in the country. We’re not going to let culture wars and conspiracy theories bring our schools down to the level of Florida or Texas.

**As long as I'm representing the 7th district, I will do my best to stay accessible, to be guided by my constituents not by cable news, and to try to find a responsible common ground on these issues. Let's be done with politicians who cynically stoke fear and rage for power and fame.**

Thank you,

Tom Malinowski

---

Even though they are up against a huge Republican supermajority, Democrats in the State House still manage to deliver wins for our state.
* **Representative Yusuf Hakeem (D - Chattanooga) and Senator Raumesh Akbari (D - Memphis) passed SB 2501, a bill that requires Black history to be taught in schools.** All our children deserve to learn about great Black historical figures in Tennessee and beyond. Now, that education is a required part of the curriculum.
* **Representative Bob Freeman (D - Nashville) passed HB2309, a bill that allows immigrants to access professional and commercial licenses.** Immigrants are an important part of our vibrant community. Breaking down unnecessary barriers barring them from work opportunities will be a huge boost to our economic and workforce recovery efforts.
* **Representative Bob Freeman (D - Nashville) introduced HB 0673, a bill that protects the identity of victims of domestic violence, sexual assault, stalking, or human trafficking.** Though this bill failed due to an undemocratic voice vote, the support for this bill is strong for future sessions. Survivors deserve the right to protect their identity from public association with their abuse, and this is an important next step towards recovery.

body:
Fellow Conservative:

The media doesn't want to know what was in Hunter Biden's laptop, but Ron Johnson does. And right now, he's finding the truth faster than they can cover it up.
That's why the Senate Conservatives Fund is proud to support Senator Johnson again in 2022. We supported him when he first ran in 2010 as a Tea Party conservative. He vowed to "join the fight, not the club," and he has kept his word.
Please help Ron Johnson continue to fight for the truth!
You can donate directly to his campaign and any of our other endorsed Senate candidates. SCF will pay all processing fees, so these principled candidates receive 100% of your contributions.
Six years ago, Washington Republicans left Senator Johnson for dead. Fake news polls had him behind, so Mitch McConnell cut him off from official GOP funds in the heat of his reelection race. But grassroots conservatives rallied and helped Johnson pull out a huge win.
This could happen again, so conservatives across the country need to work harder than ever to support Ron Johnson now.
As you know, Republican Senators usually start to take it easy in their second terms. They start going to cocktail parties and hanging out with lobbyists. They join McConnell's club and go RINO.
But Ron Johnson has stayed true and he's not slowing down.
✅ He has done more to uncover the truth about Covid-19's origins than the CDC.
✅ He has done more to expose the facts about Hunter Biden's laptop than the FBI.
✅ He has uncovered more facts about the Left's manipulation of the 2020 vote than any elected official in the country.
Conservatives need Ron Johnson in the Senate - to fight for our country, and find the truth about the Swamp's corruption.
Please contribute $10, $25, $50, or more to Senator Ron Johnson's Senate campaign today!
Your support matters. This is a highly competitive Senate race that will likely be the most expensive one in the country. We can't let Senator Johnson lose to the liberals who are destroying our country.
Thank you for considering this urgent request and for doing so much to help build a conservative Senate.

Sincerely,

Mary Vought

Thank you to everyone who signed up to join our team during the last two debates. My team ran me through the numbers, and I'm blown away by the support.

Candidates don't generally do this, but I wanted to explain a decision that my team made. Some might argue that it's unconventional, but I believe that it's the way to win this race — and the right thing to do.

In the last stretch of the campaign, candidates will often spend their time traveling to big donor events around the country in order to raise as much money as they can for TV ads.

Over the next few weeks until the primary, that's not what I'm doing.

I'll be here in Pennsylvania. I'll be at train stations and retirement homes and union halls and in coffee shops. I'm not doing much other than talking to voters, as many as possible.

I'm doing that because it's what voters deserve, and also because there are so many undecided voters in this race. We gained a lot during the debates over the last week, but for many voters, that was their first time getting to know me and what I stand for.

**Give them a chance to look you up and down, ask you tough questions, and hear where you stand on the issues that matter to them.**

| David joined John Bachman on Newsmax yesterday and talked about getting criminals off our streets, securing our elections, and making sure Stacey Abrams never becomes Governor of Georgia.

_**GETTING CRIMINALS OFF OUR STREETS**_
70% of counties in Florida have an agreement with ICE to detect and deport illegal criminals. In Georgia, only 3% of our counties have that agreement.

"I'm calling on our Governor to really get serious about this because it's a crisis here in Georgia, just like it is on our southwest border. I don't know any state right now that's not dramatically affected by two million illegals coming across that border in the last year."

**Click[HERE](https://davidperduega.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1eaf1761f5031bae92fd4e677&id=457d45eede&e=89fb4d5220) to watch.**

* * *

_**SECURING OUR ELECTIONS**_
David Perdue will make sure our elections are NEVER stolen again.

"I want a law enforcement agency dedicated solely to election law enforcement. In addition, I want outside, independent audits of any certifiable race. We have to get serious about getting rid of these voting machines. People have lost confidence in them. This is something that we need to do to get integrity and confidence back in our voting system."

**Click[HERE](https://davidperduega.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1eaf1761f5031bae92fd4e677&id=85cde44676&e=89fb4d5220) to watch.**

* * *

_**SAVING GEORGIA**_
The only reason David is running for Governor is to save our state.

"In Georgia right now, one of the major issues in this election is the way that our Governor caved in to Stacey Abrams, sold out, and actually let the Democrats take over our elections."

"The number one goal here is to make sure Stacey Abrams and that liberal woke mob don't take over the state of Georgia."

Every dollar you can spare will help us build the strongest grassroots operation to defeat Rubio, flip Florida blue and defend our Senate majority.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44621370/342395871/-74008005?refcode=20220427_Demings&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDcxODYwZC00Y2M2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qn4L4P8VAXMVjXEi7aagSFlc0mtybhdg_L4N1CDWjTE=) Every day, I carry with me that I am a descendent of enslaved people, people who knew that they would not make it, but dreamed and prayed that one day I would. [**I stand on the side of our democratic institutions, on the side of everyday working Floridians – but I need your help to win this race. We're at an inflection point for our democracy that will decide if we live up to John Lewis' dream, friend. The modern-day Republican Party is committed to the exact opposite of what Congressman Lewis stood for. Marco Rubio and Senate Republicans grow more extreme by the day, more committed to a dangerous, anti-democratic agenda. You have my word, that when it comes to winning this race and delivering better leadership for Florida, I will fight like never before. clean_body: | | | = Friend, I'm Val Demings, and I'm running for the U.S. Senate to defeat Marco Rubio and win better, stronger leadership for the people of Florida. Just 10,033 votes (0.2 percentage points) decided Florida's last Senate race – so I'll tell you the plain truth: I cannot win this without you. = Every day, I carry with me that I am a descendent of enslaved people, people who knew that they would not make it, but dreamed and prayed that one day I would. Their prayers carried me to this day – carried me through a life of public service as a social worker, as a law enforcement officer, the first Black woman to serve as Orlando's police chief, and as the proud representative of Florida's 10th Congressional district. So hear me when I say this: Only in America can a little Black girl, the daughter of a maid and a janitor growing up in the South in the ’60s, have an amazing story of opportunity like mine. The prayers of my parents propel me forward, even now, giving me the strength and courage it takes to do what's right. To impeach and prosecute a corrupt president. To never stop fighting for gun safety reform. To push for truth, accountability, justice. = In my decades of public service, I've worked with some truly incredible individuals – champions of civil rights like my friend John Lewis, who said, "Each generation must do its part to create an even more fair, more just society." We're at an inflection point for our democracy that will decide if we live up to John Lewis' dream, friend. The modern-day Republican Party is committed to the exact opposite of what Congressman Lewis stood for. Marco Rubio and Senate Republicans grow more extreme by the day, more committed to a dangerous, anti-democratic agenda. Putting party over the future of our democracy, over the wants and needs of Florida's working families. You have my word, that when it comes to winning this race and delivering better leadership for Florida, I will fight like never before. Because when your friends and neighbors put their trust in you to be their voice, you work for them – and that's just not what we're seeing from Sen. Rubio. But it's only together that we'll have a shot at winning – so here's what I'm counting on: 6,112 donations, before 11:59 p.m. tonight. ## Is James Lankford Responsible For The Outcome Of The 2020 Election?
---
**January 6, 2021** was one of the _craziest days_ in the history of the United States. It was on this day that [James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=8205027.5655.1.96deb8afe372b7387b59bd08e9346e25) entered into the US Capitol with plans to be a **HERO** by not certifying the fraudulent election of Joe Biden. [Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=8205027.5656.1.8eb556a2680a77219ad3fe5e1474fb96) was very clear that he would not certify the electors from Arizona due to the amount of **unprecedented fraud**. While in the middle of [Lankford's](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=8205027.5657.1.7a354cc1e3bbb3578eca7e2e21e2e6fb) passionate speech on the Senate floor about all the reasons he could not Constitutionally certify Joe Biden, the unexpected happened.... the protestors were _let in_. At that moment [Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=8205027.5658.1.2eb46dda4c86ee349cbed67bb17f9888) and his colleagues hid in the basement for six hours. Upon returning to the Senate floor, [James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=8205027.5659.1.5d782ebbfe1c85ed1a54be3c9c62c9bd) was the first to make the motion to certify Joe Biden as the President of the United States. This happened after he gave a speech on national television about why he **could not certify**. We all wonder why [James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=8205027.5660.1.a36a0466625e67033ee0213dc76cf824) had a sudden change of heart during those six hours in the basement. But, there is another question worth asking: **Why was[James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=8205027.5661.1.7efb9252d4dd0bda73fcb56475b8e31c) willing to not certify the 2020 election when it was politically expedient?** _He had inside baseball_.... Watch this two minute [video](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=8205027.5662.1.4758f43f2f770acf0f99ffed63b863f7) that exposes what [Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=8205027.5663.1.ea11cb252b68dea4e1a99f2ac512e287) knew leading up to the 2020 Election and what he did because of what he knew: [https://youtu.be/QL2QJrVLvSQ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=8205027.5664.1.fcfe316fd31226490e0842dabc11ab28) Thank you,

#### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq**
While in most parts of the country, senate candidates are squaring off in debates, once again, it's completely dead in Indiana. Why? It's not because the major party candidates didn't have competition. Oh trust me, they did. They had plenty of great competition.

The truth is the “machine” worked hard to remove them from competing according to outdated, exclusionary ballot access laws and used the Indiana Election Commission to justify their means. If they can't control how you vote, they’ll make every effort to control _who_ you get to vote for. Now, Hoosiers don't have any choice in their own state’s primary. I say enough is enough.

I joined this race back in 2020 because I believed Hoosiers deserved to have a _real_ voice. **Where there's no competition, there's exploitation!** That's why I stand firmly behind my decision to give Hoosiers the choice they should have had. Change never comes easy, but it is on the horizon. Stick with me!
Now, here's what I need you to do right now:
* Forward this message to nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform them that I meant what I said at the beginning of my campaign when I said I would run for the Senate until **_we_** all won!

Sincerely,
Haneefah Khaaliq, Esq.
Indiana Candidate for U.S. Senate
2022

Hello friend, we're almost to the finish line! What a year it has been since I launched last April! I wanted to email a friendly reminder that early

Hello friend,

We're almost to the finish line! What a year it has been since I launched last April!

I wanted to email a friendly reminder that early voting begins tomorrow, April 28th, and ends Saturday, May 14th for the 2022 District 12 Congressional primary. Tuesday, May 17th is Election Day.

Would you do me a favor? I'm calling on you to share my name by forwarding this email or texting 15 of your closest friends, family, and / or network of people who live in north Charlotte, Huntersville, Cornelius, Davidson, Kannapolis, Concord, Mint Hill, and Matthews area.

Thank you for your prayers, support, and vote during this upcoming Primary Election. God bless you!

Best regards,

Tyler Lee

Many elected officials fear the NRA.
#

Friends -
Many elected officials fear the NRA. They fear their campaign spending and they fear the small minority of their members that occupy the extreme far-right.
But that fear must be nothing like the fear a parent feels when they hear that their child’s school is on lockdown, or there’s been a shooting in the neighborhood.
Just last week, we learned that guns were the leading cause of death in America for children between the ages of 1 and 19.
That’s more than drug overdoses and more than car accidents.
Number 1.
Congress knows this terrible fact. They also know how to keep our children safer. They know expanding background checks will work. They know safe storage laws work, too.
But they refuse to act. Out of fear.
Or more honestly, cowardice.
We have been able to chip away at that fear over the years—pretty dramatically, in fact. Today, many candidates are proud to have an F rating from the NRA, but not enough. We need your help to continue that work. And one day, soon we believe, we’ll get the federal change we need to keep our kids safe:

It's why I ran for this office, and it is why I'm supporting former Maryland Attorney General Doug Gansler to be the | | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zJ7b5wNyzKPLhTo-AgqfOTj9hmS-8LvnA8qY7ch-DzuiPVKuiqHPoL-yAdpVvdpqxX2p_M0BYkMiaJ4QHyZXfW0P5O_YxEB7DgKT4ZbvbmdZ8CYI2MMdzp1u5NmtmP_Ap09npSCfqCDMS1msR2W5eMuVB_V9BB4O68UQccuIji9DUy3pTeknwc2-QxjWpJtjeWRAh4-QRFUDXd9TaeOG_XgbyCseYom3oawAnH3Ip1-Gc848N6KVaFsjUtR_rV7Np_epzQOP930cAIq1-DcZVUyaT3fcwKcfMfjiK9HPwd2tOw4R1D9T2GV4k52aWnn96qMOz1ES6rJFu_dqoRf6YquSyG2WmWmUjK4cAwH7rhqg/3lk/a-F5x3laTgCbbpMw7ZCcmg/h0/DRkZf6JhH1pgSFbiTnTbQ0Pct9x4ZZGqL856XeUTFP8)

Friends, As a former prosecutor and as the current Attorney General of Delaware, I know the number one job of government is to keep people safe. **That's why I'm supporting former Maryland Attorney General Doug Gansler to be the next Governor of Maryland.** With violent crime on the rise everywhere, now more than ever states need leaders who know what it takes to build safe, thriving communities. **How do I know Doug Gansler will put the safety of you and your family first?**_Because I have seen him do it at every juncture._ As Attorney General, he introduced legislation to get guns out of the hands of domestic abusers. As Montgomery County State's Attorney, committed to justice, he assigned his prosecutors to communities to ensure they knew the neighborhoods they served. He established drug courts so law enforcement could focus on violent drug crimes, not petty possession offenses. Doug also spearheaded the establishment of domestic violence dockets and the Family Justice Center, providing families with the services needed to break the cycle of violence. And as an Assistant US Attorney, he personally prosecuted hundreds of cases of homicide, sexual assault, and violent crime. Doug also knows that keeping you safe requires more than just fighting crime. **Keeping people safe means building strong communities.** That's why, as President of our National Association, he fought to get billions of dollars from the Mortgage Foreclosure Crisis Settlement, helping keep Marylanders in their homes. It's why he took on corporate polluters, getting some of the largest settlements in American history. **As we emerge from the pandemic and begin to rebuild our economy, you can count on Doug Gansler to put you and your family and your community _first_.** Having worked with every state agency, Attorneys General walk into the job ready to govern, prepared to push past partisan divides to serve the people on the issues that matter to them most. _Doug Gansler is that Governor._ And if you don't believe me, perhaps you'll believe the other 40 Attorneys General, former and present, who have put their names behind Doug Gansler's campaign to become the next Governor of Maryland. Sincerely, Kathy Jennings _Delaware Attorney General_

clean_body: As a former prosecutor and as the current Attorney General of Delaware, I know the number one job of government is to keep people safe. It's why I ran for this office, and it is why I'm supporting former Maryland Attorney General Doug Gansler to be the | | Friends, As a former prosecutor and as the current Attorney General of Delaware, I know the number one job of government is to keep people safe. That's why I'm supporting former Maryland Attorney General Doug Gansler to be the next Governor of Maryland. With violent crime on the rise everywhere, now more than ever states need leaders who know what it takes to build safe, thriving communities. How do I know Doug Gansler will put the safety of you and your family first?Because I have seen him do it at every juncture. As Attorney General, he introduced legislation to get guns out of the hands of domestic abusers. As Montgomery County State's Attorney, committed to justice, he assigned his prosecutors to communities to ensure they knew the neighborhoods they served. He established drug courts so law enforcement could focus on violent drug crimes, not petty possession offenses. Doug also spearheaded the establishment of domestic violence dockets and the Family Justice Center, providing families with the services needed to break the cycle of violence. And as an Assistant US Attorney, he personally prosecuted hundreds of cases of homicide, sexual assault, and violent crime. Doug also knows that keeping you safe requires more than just fighting crime. Keeping people safe means building strong communities. That's why, as President of our National Association, he fought to get billions of dollars from the Mortgage Foreclosure Crisis Settlement, helping keep Marylanders in their homes. It's why he took on corporate polluters, getting some of the largest settlements in American history. As we emerge from the pandemic and begin to rebuild our economy, you can count on Doug Gansler to put you and your family and your community first. Having worked with every state agency, Attorneys General walk into the job ready to govern, prepared to push past partisan divides to serve the people on the issues that matter to them most. Doug Gansler is that Governor. And if you don't believe me, perhaps you'll believe the other 40 Attorneys General, former and present, who have put their names behind Doug Gansler's campaign to become the next Governor of Maryland. Friend,

I won’t lie: When I think about all the terrible things Ron DeSantis has done to Florida and our people during his time as governor, I can feel my blood pressure rise. It seems there’s _no end_ to what he’ll do to advance his own political career.

DeSantis signed legislation **targeting LGBTQ+ kids in the classroom** , outright banning any discussion of gender issues and further marginalizing already vulnerable students. We should be nurturing _all_ of Florida’s future leaders, not tormenting some for political gain.

He signed **the most restrictive anti-choice legislation** in Florida’s history since _Roe v. Wade_ , banning almost all abortions with no exceptions for horrible situations like rape or incest. It’s a monstrous law, but it won him points in his primary, so he supports it.

He’s determined to silence _anyone_ who opposes him, and he’s even gone so far as to **bully children** at one of his press events, telling them they looked “ridiculous” for refusing to conform to his political agenda.

And now he’s **banning math textbooks**! Sadly, you can’t make this stuff up.

Suffice it to say the stakes could not be higher in this November’s election. With DeSantis eyeing a run for president in 2024, there’s no telling what he’d do with a second term as governor if he thought it would help him get to the White House.

**The good news is a recent Listener Group poll shows me outright BEATING the governor in November. But to maintain that lead and get Florida back on the right track, I need your grassroots support. Will you pitch in right now to help keep up the momentum?**

### Representative Pauline Wendzel Endorses Michael Brown for Governor: “He is the Governor We Need.”
Michael Brown’s campaign for Governor released a statement today from State Representative Pauline Wendzel endorsing him and calling him, “the Governor we need.”

“I want to add my name to those supporting Michael Brown for Governor of Michigan,” stated Representative Wendzel. “Captain Mike has been an invaluable resource to me as a State Representative on law enforcement issues and initiatives to improve public safety.”
---
|
---
| “Like me, he grew up working in farming before his service in the U.S. Marine Corps, as a County Commissioner, and his current leadership role as a Commander in the Michigan State Police,” she continued. “He is the Governor we need.”

Michael Brown commented that he was grateful for Wendzel’s support. “Pauline Wendzel is a leader in the state legislature, and in her local community. I’m extremely appreciative of her support and look forward to working with her to fix the issues in Michigan.”

Wendzel becomes the second State Representative to endorse Brown. Previously Representative Beth Griffin endorsed Brown. In addition to the legislative endorsements, Brown has picked up endorsements from County Sheriffs, County Prosecutors, County Commissioners, and many others.

body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
I am honored to announce that I have been awarded the 2022 Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate distinction. Moms Demand Action awards this distinction to candidates who advocate for gun violence prevention, and who are committed to governing with gun safety in mind.
https://secure.ngpvan.com/UmcZ-F7aSE6W89FfwCA4sw2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/UmcZ-F7aSE6W89FfwCA4sw2]
I have an extensive track record fighting for increased gun safety. As a State Delegate in 1988, I fought to make Maryland the first state in the nation to ban the sale and manufacture of cheap handguns. And following the 2021 mass shooting in Boulder, Colorado, I called on Congress to pass gun safety legislation to hold manufacturers responsible. As Governor, I’ll continue to fight for common-sense gun safety measures, I’ll stand up to the NRA, and I’ll partner with groups like Moms Demand Action to keep our communities safe.
If you agree that we need to combat the gun violence crisis, then will you add your name to support our efforts to achieve greater gun safety in Maryland? By making our voices heard, you can help us spread our message to voters in all corners of the state, so that we can build the critical mass of support needed to win this competitive primary. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/UmcZ-F7aSE6W89FfwCA4sw2]
America has some of the worst statistics in the world when it comes to gun violence. We cannot accept these tragedies as an unpreventable occurrence – we must combat this crisis with comprehensive policies that keep our communities safe and keep weapons out of the hands of dangerous individuals.
Thank you,
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/Franchot%20Signature.png]

subject: Running for office was never in my life plan.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Kim Schrier for Congress
body:
I want to tell you the story of how I came to Congress. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44612559/342365738/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzNmMmNjMi0zYWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kOxAHokyunLXqhLPqF3zEk9B121CfB-ssKKRG94INis=&emci=59cf610f-7cc5-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=733f2cc2-3ac6-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15820338)
---
In a moment, I'm going to ask you to **[contribute to my campaign before our end-of-month fundraising deadline](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44612560/342365740/1643066332?refcode=em22_220427_eoq1rs_fnd_gq_nopn___dks_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220427_eoq1rs_fnd_gq_nopn___dks_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzNmMmNjMi0zYWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kOxAHokyunLXqhLPqF3zEk9B121CfB-ssKKRG94INis=)** , but first, I want to let you know why I first chose to run for Congress.

I never imagined I'd run for office, Peter.

When I was sixteen years old, I was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes. I always had a love for science (here I am winning an academic decathlon when I was in high school!), and my experience managing my diabetes and all the time I spent in doctors’ offices helped lead me to a career as a pediatrician. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44612561/342365741/1643066332?refcode=em22_220427_eoq1rs_fnd_gq_nopn___dks_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220427_eoq1rs_fnd_gq_nopn___dks_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzNmMmNjMi0zYWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kOxAHokyunLXqhLPqF3zEk9B121CfB-ssKKRG94INis=) For sixteen years, I served thousands of families in Issaquah as a doctor. I loved my patients and my work. Running for office was never in my "life plan." [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44612562/342365743/1643066332?refcode=em22_220427_eoq1rs_fnd_gq_nopn___dks_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220427_eoq1rs_fnd_gq_nopn___dks_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzNmMmNjMi0zYWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kOxAHokyunLXqhLPqF3zEk9B121CfB-ssKKRG94INis=) But throughout my career, I saw firsthand how important access to quality, affordable health care was for my patients. That's why when my own representative voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act, that was the final straw for me.

So, I packed up my office and left the job I love to run for Congress. I had a sense that I could do more good for more children and families in Washington's 8th District from a seat in the House of Representatives than I ever could in the 4 walls of my exam room. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44612563/342365747/1643066332?refcode=em22_220427_eoq1rs_fnd_gq_nopn___dks_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220427_eoq1rs_fnd_gq_nopn___dks_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzNmMmNjMi0zYWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kOxAHokyunLXqhLPqF3zEk9B121CfB-ssKKRG94INis=) I knew it wasn't going to be easy – no Democrat had ever represented Washington's 8th District before. But folks from all across the district came together to join me because they believed in what I was fighting for: affordable health care, a clean environment, education, and so much more. In fact, many of the people who joined me to knock doors and get out the vote were my patients and their families! It was incredible and heartwarming.

**Thanks to grassroots supporters like you, we flipped Washington's 8th District blue for the first time ever in 2018 and kept it blue in 2020.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44612564/342365748/1643066332?refcode=em22_220427_eoq1rs_fnd_gq_nopn___dks_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220427_eoq1rs_fnd_gq_nopn___dks_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzNmMmNjMi0zYWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kOxAHokyunLXqhLPqF3zEk9B121CfB-ssKKRG94INis=) Since coming to Congress, I have been focused on fighting for the issues that matter most to you, me, and all the families I served as a pediatrician.

We've accomplished so much over the past three years, but there's more work ahead of us. That's why I'm running for re-election this November. But protecting my seat won't be easy. National Republicans have named this district a top target and election experts are saying this race will be a "toss-up." That’s alarming when there is so much at stake in this election.

We're facing our end-of-month deadline in just a few days, and we set an ambitious online fundraising goal to ensure we have the resources to defend my seat and our Democratic House majority. I don't accept a dime of corporate PAC money, so I can't get there without your support.

**[Will you chip in $5 or more before our end-of-month fundraising deadline? Together, we can keep this seat blue and continue making progress for the 8th District.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44612565/342365753/1643066332?refcode=em22_220427_eoq1rs_fnd_gq_nopn___dks_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220427_eoq1rs_fnd_gq_nopn___dks_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzNmMmNjMi0zYWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kOxAHokyunLXqhLPqF3zEk9B121CfB-ssKKRG94INis=)**

Thank you,

clean_body: I want to tell you the story of how I came to Congress. In a moment, I'm going to ask you to = , but first, I want to let you know why I first chose to run for Congress. I never imagined I'd run for office, Peter. When I was sixteen years old, I was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes. I always had a love for science (here I am winning an academic decathlon when I was in high school!), and my experience managing my diabetes and all the time I spent in doctors’ offices helped lead me to a career as a pediatrician. = For sixteen years, I served thousands of families in Issaquah as a doctor. I loved my patients and my work. Running for office was never in my "life plan." = But throughout my career, I saw firsthand how important access to quality, affordable health care was for my patients. That's why when my own representative voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act, that was the final straw for me. So, I packed up my office and left the job I love to run for Congress. I had a sense that I could do more good for more children and families in Washington's 8th District from a seat in the House of Representatives than I ever could in the 4 walls of my exam room. = I knew it wasn't going to be easy – no Democrat had ever represented Washington's 8th District before. But folks from all across the district came together to join me because they believed in what I was fighting for: affordable health care, a clean environment, education, and so much more. In fact, many of the people who joined me to knock doors and get out the vote were my patients and their families! It was incredible and heartwarming. Thanks to grassroots supporters like you, we flipped Washington's 8th District blue for the first time ever in 2018 and kept it blue in 2020. = Since coming to Congress, I have been focused on fighting for the issues that matter most to you, me, and all the families I served as a pediatrician. We've accomplished so much over the past three years, but there's more work ahead of us. That's why I'm running for re-election this November. But protecting my seat won't be easy. National Republicans have named this district a top target and election experts are saying this race will be a "toss-up." That’s alarming when there is so much at stake in this election. We're facing our end-of-month deadline in just a few days, and we set an ambitious online fundraising goal to ensure we have the resources to defend my seat and our Democratic House majority. body:
Proud to share that Obi Ezeadi has endorsed Neal Walia for Congress | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/098bd309b254/endorsement-alert-obi-ezeadi?e=e67cbb3f92)
---
| | | |
---
| | | | **Hello Friend,** **I am so proud to announce that Obi Ezeadi has endorsed my campaign for Colorado's First Congressional District!**
---
|
---
|
###
Obi is an inspiration to so many, especially to those of us who come from immigrant backgrounds. He defied all odds as an outsider to establishment politics when he won his race in 2021 and has since been a voice of hope and progress for marginalized communities who have been underserved by their elected officials. His positivity and vision are desperately needed in Colorado politics. I am extremely proud to receive his endorsement!

In Solidarity,
Neal Walia
Candidate, CO First Congressional District
www.nealwaliaforcongress.com

###

Neal is the son of immigrant parents who migrated to this country from India in pursuit of better opportunities for their children and their families. In his time at the University of Colorado-Boulder, Neal got involved in campus organizing as the President of the South Asian Student Association and was elected to serve in the university’s student government. He then got his first foot in the door of politics while interning for then Congressman Mark Udall’s office. Neal brought his passion for public service to Governor Hickenlooper’s office, working in his Office of Community Partnerships tackling homelessness and build bridges between our state government and the AAPI community. This work brought him to Washington with the National Governors Association, which opened his eyes to the underside of national politics. Neal is running for Congress in Colorado’s 1st Congressional District because he wants to be a champion for our most vulnerable communities. Neal’s campaign was recently endorsed by PK Kaiser and the National Progressive Democrats of America.

| Hello from the final week on the campaign trail!
The countdown is here and #TeamGibbons has been meeting voters everywhere in Ohio. This week, I've had the pleasure of meeting with Ohio College Republicans, MOVAC Marietta, Perry County Republicans and Licking County conservatives.
It's been a busy week and I can't believe we have just six days until Election Day. Today I'm speaking to several different groups in the Cleveland area. Come say hello at our event at Pizzazz on the Circle at 6:30 tonight.

You can sign up for a yard sign [here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OxUydBQc9hOP6FS4gmQHJjhI2WLdPopgByxHOpn2UJYoY3gz2YRtUc8Mg75M3DlekXkL5baxJiYFuooNJSyDvmPGTIx6IdmpWzjc06dhePmW0-ZUU8ptVgunye0l4rQJz6jvMzSPasQGgXb2A5psVJmD4NbzTGeCDj-9Z-xNeCQ=&c=ovvtEM6HUoII12EJm7OSoyau5rRAZcIdYx4AxzPMbcmsOfMKeoOntw==&ch=XarhnlntCar2lqa8fVkIhzc18qRzJBbWscSPxfGRNKHd8ID9e-vTQA==) to show your support for my campaign, or sign up to volunteer.

Mike Gibbons Candidate for U.S. Senate

Jim

name: Erica Smith
subject: Growing up Black in the South
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ERICA FOR US
body:
#
Hi, it’s Erica.
I’m writing to you today because our final fundraising deadline before our May primary election is in a few days, and making the hard ask for financial support is not comfortable.
**So I wanted to tell you more about who I am before**[** _I respectfully ask you to make a donation to our final fundraising effort — our Finish Line Fund — before April 31._**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/50651?t=1&akid=1128%2E3698%2EKJe5yI)
I’m Erica Smith. I’m a single mom, engineer, educator, minister, and three-term state senator. Growing up Black in the South was difficult. But our elders taught us the dignity of work and the value of faith.
I was raised on a dirt road in rural North Carolina — the same dirt road that my mother was raised on. My five siblings and I grew up picking cucumbers and corn on the family farm. **Now it’s 2022, and my mother still lives on the same dirt road, waiting for it to be paved.**
[****](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/50651?t=2&akid=1128%2E3698%2EKJe5yI)
All across North Carolina and America, good people are waiting on their roads to be paved. We are waiting for affordable health care, waiting for a living wage, and waiting for a representative who understands what it means to struggle, and who will fight for transformative change.
We can be that change. I’m running for Congress to create opportunities for communities like mine. **Together we can win a living wage, bold climate action, universal broadband, reproductive justice and so much more.**
If elected, I will fight tirelessly for North Carolinians — and I’d be one of the few Black women to ever represent the state in Congress.
[**_If you’re with me, will you please make a donation of $5 or more to our Finish Line Fund before April 30 at midnight? We’ve set a goal of raising $50,000 because this is one of the most competitive races in the country. I genuinely need your support to win._**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/50651?t=3&akid=1128%2E3698%2EKJe5yI)
**[Donate $5](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/50657?refcode=em20220427-1128&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=1128%2E3698%2EKJe5yI)**
Thank you for taking a personal stake in this campaign,
Erica

name: Pro Life Update
subject: A bright light during dark hours
body:
Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, cons
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zme6226maeatstvg477goqvg88toa2klabhalkcg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2u5qm2dr46tineclhehhm0or2mlhj4tjlc8q7eddjc5h6ao34scp66tbhc8p62s77q9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphhmipm0ptnc5j75c5lm9jr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or5chg61p74sdgm49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zv5b34k997o4uu59llsh9ieqaodmashes4rlk0io_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c1ge9p73c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News_ because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—like our free online courses. __ And though we’re best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author—C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **“[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zco4mu4piujtidfi3nr6slj0sojhbkk4i9dnfdig_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c1ge9p73c5h2bs)” **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That’s why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z7g8i4fti1irj4ppt3eodh0vmbb48cgk4n4kbhgo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c1ge9p73c5h2bs),” **we’ve received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis’ writings. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zqfs52cu2r8diidueqamuv1s9lgfa66b8jbmgs7g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c1ge9p73c5h2bs) We’ve also heard from many of our friends that they would love to own a DVD version. So, I’m pleased to announce that the C.S. Lewis course is available on DVD for your home library. You can also give it as a gift or use it in a small group, such as a Bible study or book club. We only made a few of these special sets, so get this premium edition of **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zd0cfcevroqoire83hh2uhr7dqanh4t6sam7vm30_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c1ge9p73c5h2bs)”** on DVD today. Given how popular this course is, the DVD box set won’t last long. Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link, while they last: [**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/be-the-first-to-get-hillsdales-new-c-s-lewis-dvd-set/**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zck9295d9v23fh6ebsfl5siup5f9in7r68p5tbfo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c1ge9p73c5h2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

clean_body: Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, cons This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on Fox News because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—like our free online courses. And though we’re best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous British author—C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, “” has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark Chronicles of Narnia series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That’s why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching “,” we’ve received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis’ writings. We’ve also heard from many of our friends that they would love to own a DVD version. So, I’m pleased to announce that the C.S. Lewis course is available on DVD for your home library. You can also give it as a gift or use it in a small group, such as a Bible study or book club. We only made a few of these special sets, so get this premium edition of “” on DVD today. Given how popular this course is, the DVD box set won’t last long. With the midterms just around the corner, we need all hands on deck to support Alexandria’s re-election and her bold leadership in Congress.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220427-2981-header&t=1&akid=2981%2E2526796%2EmodaA3)
With just three days before our fundraising deadline, we wanted to share a sneak peek into our ActBlue fundraising.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220427?refcode=em20220427-2981-P_FND_EOM_GFM&t=2&refcode2=2981_2526796_modaA3&akid=2981%2E2526796%2EmodaA3)
**Our average contribution for the month of April is $14.85, and we’re pretty proud of that number.** Our grassroots movement is powered by thousands of individuals like you, pitching in $14.85 or whatever you can, to support our movement.
**Your donations, no matter how big or small, allow Alexandria to continue her bold leadership in Congress.** Over the past few months alone, Alexandria fought to amend the Ban Conflicted Trading Act to ban both senior staff and member’s spouses who boast an unfair advantage from trading stocks, continued the fight to cancel student debt – making the case to President Biden directly – and secured $7 million for community projects in The Bronx and Queens.
**But our next test is securing 287 more donations before the end of the month.** If we can reach this goal, we will be in a good position to carry out all of the programs that Alexandria has planned.
**We’re so much closer to changing this country for the better and building the future our communities deserve.** Making a donation now is critical to keeping up this momentum as we approach the New York primaries this June.
[Will you make a $14.85 donation – or whatever you can – to keep Alexandria in Congress and continue building strength for our priorities as we approach the end of this month? ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220427?refcode=em20220427-2981-P_FND_EOM_GFM&t=3&refcode2=2981_2526796_modaA3&akid=2981%2E2526796%2EmodaA3)
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220427?refcode=em20220427-2981-P_FND_EOM_GFM&t=22&refcode2=2981_2526796_modaA3&akid=2981%2E2526796%2EmodaA3)**
As the month of April comes to a close, we are that much closer to both the New York State primaries and the 2022 midterm election. This is a pivotal moment for not only Alexandria, but the progressive movement as a whole.
**We need all hands on deck to support Alexandria, her leadership, and our priorities in Congress.**
[So what do you say? Will you donate $14.85 – or whatever you can – to support Alexandria's re-election and the progressive movement heading into the midterms? ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220427?refcode=em20220427-2981-P_FND_EOM_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&refcode2=2981_2526796_modaA3&akid=2981%2E2526796%2EmodaA3)
Thank you for everything you do to sustain our movement.
\- Team AOC

body:
| My team sent you an email yesterday about the National Journal officially labeling our race in danger of flipping red in November.

The truth is we already knew our race was a toss up thanks to redistricting, but this new classification by the National Journal definitely means our opponents are organizing to defeat us.

**Will you help my team spread our positive message by donating right away? We’re launching our campaign door-to-door canvassing this weekend and now, we’ll need to triple our impact.**

**[https://go.dankildee.com/a/apr22-goal](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44619949/342389247/399374053?amount=15&contactdata=lQ6NjtdDbEBm2AsLesJrYxGHCYzOIlrDw9Sj8PVi8ZebKTsxCvuSnpKQiVZU/8uu4DYKenYx2qP3p5kxKb6jtpEFpF3vYmq8+hua3RB//CqaUdG0fI1u+lyFmJuEiY6gD+zWVxHcFl/q5ulmuXCD8A==&refcode2=d6d4eb51-46c6-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&refcode=DK_EM_FR_3MO_220427_1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNmQ0ZWI1MS00NmM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5OtNQWSVmZdy5SEi5ZVa87gXqBAndNbovwIZf2ddDFU=)**

* * *
**BREAKING:** The National Journal is calling our race one of the top races in danger of flipping RED in November.

_Why this matters:_ Dan is fighting for mid-Michigan in Congress, but he’s competing against a National Republican fundraising machine and opponents who are self-funding their own campaigns.

_This news is only going to bring more dark money into our district, adding fuel to the fire._

My name is Wiley Nickel, and I wanted to introduce myself. I am excited to be running to represent the newly-drawn 13th Congressional district which includes Wake, Johnston, and parts of Harnett and Wayne counties. I live in Cary with my wife and children, and I have served our state as a two-term State Senator in Wake County.
As a former official for President Obama’s Administration, I know how important it is to lead by building coalitions and delivering lasting results. During my two terms in the State Senate, I’ve fought to protect our voting rights and fair elections, and to invest in public education and the health of our children. In Washington, I'll continue to work to shift the tax burden away from the middle class and deliver tangible results that cut through the infighting we see every day. As a professional fundraiser, Kirsten’s decision to sign the “No Fossil Fuel Money” pledge made me nervous. Shutting the door on a revenue stream that literally every other candidate in this race has left open puts us at a competitive disadvantage. But you know what? I respect the hell out of that decision. And, after getting to know Kirsten over these past few months, I know that decision was the right one. = Kirsten has spent her entire career protecting our planet and fighting the harmful impacts of climate change. That's why she’s endorsed by environmental champions like Congressman Raúl Grijalva, Tucson Mayor Regina Romero, and the League of Conservation Voters. As a member of her finance team, it’s my job to figure out how to make up for the fact that - unlike our opponents - we’re refusing all contributions from the fossil fuel industry. But that’s where you come in. Time and time again, when Kirsten and the team have asked, you’ve stepped up. Which is why I’m asking you today to help us prove that candidates don’t need fossil fuel money to be successful. If you’ve read this far, you probably agree with that statement. body:

---
| |
---
|
Dear Friend,

The Mississippi Justice Institute (MJI) has scored another victory for freedom in Mississippi!

The Wall Street Journal editorial board – whose members oversee the most widely-read editorial page in the world – even [weighed in](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=fec7506efb&e=5703353baa) on the victory, saying: “Mississippi residents have the highest obesity rate in the U.S., but the state is about to shed a few regulatory pounds. Raise your protein shake to personal trainer Donna Harris and her lawyers at the Mississippi Justice Institute.”

Our client, Donna Harris, is a fitness instructor and occupational therapist with a bachelor’s degree in nutrition and a master’s in occupational therapy. In 2020, she started a weight-loss program for paying customers that became an overnight success. But then the government threatened to throw her in jail for telling people how to drop a few pounds without having a dietician’s license. All of her advertisements made clear she was not a licensed dietician and was not trying to treat medical conditions. Rather, she was only giving advice to healthy people about the age-old topic of weight loss. But none of that mattered to the government.
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=790f2227e7&e=5703353baa)
---
|
Donna had to refund all of her customers, but she fought back, suing the State for violating her right to free speech. And now, thanks to her lawsuit, anyone in Mississippi can now offer weight-loss advice as long as they do not claim to be a dietitian.

Allowing people to speak freely about general health and nutrition is a no-brainer, especially in a state like ours that struggles with obesity. The government should not be able to give any group a monopoly on speech about a common, everyday topic, like what food we should buy at the grocery store if we want to stay healthy or drop a few pounds. This victory will increase Mississippians’ access to important information about their health, while allowing more Mississippians to use their skills and knowledge to earn an honest living and provide for their families.

For decades, nonsensical occupational licensing regulations like these have been steadily accumulating in Mississippi and around the nation. It’s not surprising that this happened. We have been letting the fox guard the henhouse. Industry insiders regulate most professions and they have been quietly and steadily adding new rules that protect them from competition while doing little or nothing to provide better value to consumers. These rules took years to accumulate, and it will take years to trim them back to size. But seeing the impact that our efforts have in the lives of people like Donna make it a fight worth continuing.
---
| |
---
In Liberty,

Aaron Rice
Director of MJI
---
|
P.S. Check out some of the recent media coverage of Donna’s legal victory!

Industry insiders regulate most professions and they have been quietly and steadily adding new rules that protect them from competition while doing little or nothing to provide better value to consumers. These rules took years to accumulate, and it will take years to trim them back to size. But seeing the impact that our efforts have in the lives of people like Donna make it a fight worth continuing. | | In Liberty, Aaron Rice Director of MJI | P.S. Peter,

Can you believe it?

After a federal judge rejected the Biden administration’s unscientific forced masking of people on airplanes, Dr. Fauci finally emerged this week to resume his usual COVID fearmongering.

As expected, the Biden administration is attempting to fight the judge’s decision and reimpose forced masking on planes.

Frankly, Peter, this is all COVID theater. Fauci and the Biden administration are trying to impose these authoritarian mandates to prolong the misery and suffering they have caused. They want to exercise unchecked power over the people they govern.

They are trying to take decisions out of your hands and force you to comply with their orders. All they want is power and control over your lives.

But I can tell you this, as long as I am your Governor, your freedoms will always be protected.

There's a reason why we're known as the Free State of Florida. We've protected your freedoms at every turn: ensured kids were in school five days a week, ensured businesses could operate freely, and ensured you could go to church.

But if Biden and the Democrats have their way and win in November, they will force mandates and lockdown policies on all of us. I hope I can count on your continued support to stand up against the policies of the Biden-Fauci administration.

Together, we will keep Florida free.

Sincerely,

Ron DeSantis

body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWN76Y0HNF

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only
take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives-but
supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we
elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the
Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWN76Y0HNF

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent
matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but
the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by
progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to
change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do
away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a
National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to
me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more
clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning
this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and
opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on
Presidential Selection by using the link below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey

For most of our nation's history, the
Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution,
was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to
preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have
joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional
bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution
has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to
provide young people with a proper grounding in American
civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance
of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide,
directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the
Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide
through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The
Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over 5.6 million households and
businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of
liberty;

Promoting constitutional education
through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of
America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across
America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education
through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which
launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools
nationwide.

Your answers to the National Survey on
Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most
effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the
importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this
critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent
topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection
and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a
few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure
link I've provided below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey

And after you take your survey, I hope you
will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing
truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its
extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is
essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the
National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for
your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of
liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

body:
Here’s what we need today.
#
Hey, Derek.
You need to hear straight from me why today is a HUGE day for our campaign.
We’re required to file one more report with the FEC before our primary next month. **And our deadline to close the books is****midnight — tonight.**
This is the last time our fundraising numbers will be published before our primary, which means the number we report is going to be the final fundraising update voters see before heading to the polls.
In other words, Derek, **this is our last chance to prove that we are THE ONLY campaign to flip PA’s open U.S. Senate seat + protect our Democratic Senate majority. 🔵**
So, before tonight’s critical FEC deadline, I need to personally + humbly request:
**[Will you donate any amount you can before midnight to help us raise another $100,000 before we close the books? It’s what we need to finish strong.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220427-1?refcode=em20220427-5560&refcode2=5560_434096_JmPP9T&akid=5560%2E434096%2EJmPP9T)**

Thank you, thank you, thank you. I can’t tell you how grateful I am to this team. 😭
John

In other words, Derek, this is our last chance to prove that we are THE ONLY campaign to flip PA’s open U.S. Senate seat + protect our Democratic Senate majority. 🔵 So, before tonight’s critical FEC deadline, I need to personally + humbly request: Thank you, thank you, thank you. I can’t tell you how grateful I am to this team. 😭 John John Fetterman Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania | | Email us: info@johnfetterman.com

| | Dear Peter ,

This past Sunday was a big day for the campaign. After months of outreach to party delegates and leadership, we secured the endorsement of the California Republican Party. An overwhelming majority– over 63% of party delegates – voted to endorse this campaign and make me the official Republican candidate for California Attorney General.

If you check out the endorsement list below, you'll also notice some new names on Team Hochman. Along with the party endorsement, we are glad to now have the support of House Republican Leader Kevin McCarthy, Senate Republican Leader Scott Wilk, Senator Shannon Grove, Senator Pat Bates, and Assemblyman Vince Fong.

With Republicans united and Democrats and Independents joining the campaign with their contributions (over 40% of my over $1.74 million of contributions have been from Democrats and Independents) and endorsements (recently Democratic Los Angeles County Sheriff Alex Villanueva joined Republican Orange County Sheriff Don Barnes in endorsing my candidacy), I feel confident that we can win the June 7th primary and then the November 8th general election.

Ballots drop in just a couple weeks. It is critical we have the resources needed to reach millions of voters and deliver our message of public safety and equal justice for all. If you have not already donated, or have and are able to do more, please consider making a donation at the link below.

Fellow Conservative,

Why do doctors have such bad handwriting?

I have no idea why, but I’m definitely guilty of having terrible penmanship - I’ve served in the medical field for over 35 years and my handwriting has never gotten better.

Outside of my direct work in healthcare, I’ve traveled extensively for the last 35 years to Third World Countries including India, several parts of Africa, Nicaragua, and Haiti as a Medical Missionary.

But Fellow Conservative, my world got flipped upside down in 2019 when Congressman Walter B Jones, Jr. passed away after serving eastern North Carolinians for more than 22 years, and North Carolina needed someone to step up and serve.

For the past three years, I’ve spent time serving Americans in a new way: **as a U.S. congressman**. It’s not always an easy job, but after working in the medical field, I’ve learned that the most fulfilling jobs rarely are.

My campaign wants to issue a correction to our last email!

It has recently come to my campaign's attention that in California there is a bill before the state legislature, [AB 2223](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Jxwwp2gwJ7t5mwjp9VjlbCDFfTvRT7G1Fw85rC81OVmYk0Zl8B8h6cMuUSG8OBkFQ3wJp0rlAo8nixCmee2bsMCAlV29Wp-B7lSv0nNetmTVyNi0pmGR6xLd-znmyym0jKZtmB8o0UtXqTtQ9OvFBh5QkL45NwOzMseViRL8UgFDuA0cjK2exB-83tS5DQb0IgTUGVyNXAJWd2fu6nrOr2I8TIRJdSG9r-hcjhBhubw=&c=gQ0kG7oMpsdD_JtDKhepo1qIaJ7rlZqEnj7U8evMP2PM5SxI05qIZQ==&ch=N7BNHzoTy1hWsU1vyqNlt9KJRGH45_18HOHZReW6PZeRwhac9NFQ8w==), that would allow for "abortion" up to 28 days after the child is born. While this bill has not passed beyond committee, it is shocking that this would even be considered a legal remedy for anyone. This is MURDER!!! There is no other word for it.

We also want to share with you the Committee Hearing with you, you can find that here: [https://youtu.be/NS78OvBek8M](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Jxwwp2gwJ7t5mwjp9VjlbCDFfTvRT7G1Fw85rC81OVmYk0Zl8B8h6cMuUSG8OBkFGbqGre9gxHqoPKx2qeadUY5kXezZ0GAylR0mPysOwvIU4BJ3Ji404pDBfm7ug7plqe0zhrVZpBy8gZm87BF8OQ==&c=gQ0kG7oMpsdD_JtDKhepo1qIaJ7rlZqEnj7U8evMP2PM5SxI05qIZQ==&ch=N7BNHzoTy1hWsU1vyqNlt9KJRGH45_18HOHZReW6PZeRwhac9NFQ8w==)

Mark Pocan loves to cite science as his justification for his support of abortion on demand. What Mark Pocan does not understand is, the science. Over 95% of biologists have affirmed that human life begins at conception. One such biologist states, "Human development begins after the union of male and female gametes or germ cells during a process known as fertilization (conception)..." Moore, Keith L. Essentials of Human Embryology. Toronto: B.C. Decker Inc, 1988, p.2.

I will always be open and honest with you. As your representative, that is my job. Open and transparent about the issues. I apologize for this oversight!
|
### The science on abortion has been clear for decades. It is time we end the horrific practice of abortion once and for all. Abortion is not healthcare. Abortion is not a Constitutional Right. It is murder, plain and simple. I cannot wait to be on the right side of history and vote for legislation that ends abortion nationwide.

Charity Barry
