[](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=1c81ce1c3d21431991916d8f36be9e49&_m=3b8900fbaee04d70bfb3b8c6410b9c68&_e=K9h0GuxtcXgHVRAlT55nr-17iF4KwCuxzw1xOR75rLc55tg9bmLKY7HFSgwvVR4-yhkjnxUfEl_5OPzDondY9N7QN4OGlndAAvqhD8FYViAKWsdvizdLsrG1ZPi7dW37dFpkCveSJAlj2wkDuxlgzEfgOmsRUs0LS964u_fSlS943orxtV-rxwjxtxkkP0tDVJDsE_t9l2UKZtBEK-XOqLBUrxkTItZCAN2PeH4H_Q6nVk9bSiZVAn_TQc7Vpv_7g8NuovKyb68qYsEhete4qEA5AOZmUzzxbOOAfYILXO2K8ZMJnBHdbKzsbHK0wOu4) **April 27, 2022 ** Early voting has started and with one week until the primary, I am encouraging you to get out and vote for my friend and the leader Ohio needs, Matt Dolan. Matt Dolan has my support. I was proud to endorse Matt Dolan because he has proven time and time again that he is the leader we need. Given the weight of this moment, Ohioans must decide what we want as our path forward. Friend,
Last week, I testified before officials of the Environmental Protection Agency on their latest proposed policy update—strengthening the "Good Neighbor" provision of the _Clean Air Act_ to help clean up dangerous ozone pollution. As the mother of a child with asthma, I'm one of millions of Americans who feel this one personally. Now, I'm asking you to join me in supporting this new rule.
The EPA has opened a public comment period—it's our chance to flex our grassroots muscles and show up for clean air. And get this: Right now, the EPA has only received 37 comments on this rule. _Your voice will make a huge difference!_
[_**Sign an official public comment on this new policy, and we'll submit it directly to EPA decision-makers on your behalf!**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-EPA-strengthen-good-neighbor-rule/?utm_source=ema_2022-04-27_CASPAR_good_neighbor_comment_&source=ema_2022-04-27_CASPAR_good_neighbor_comment_&t=4&akid=12967%2E53494%2Ev0Rija)

Here's why this is such a big opportunity. The proposed Cross-State Air Pollution Rule is a common-sense solution to the fact that pollution from one state can impact air quality in another. It calls for upwind states to limit their pollution to protect people in the downwind states.
This policy update is groundbreaking. It would improve the rule's reporting of pollution from current sources, expand the rule's scope to cover more sources of pollution, and expand the rule's coverage to even more states, including California, Nevada, Utah, and Wyoming.
**By 2026, the proposal would provide up to $18 billion in annual benefits for the U.S. It would prevent up to 1,000 premature deaths, avoid 2,000 hospital and emergency room visits, and avert 1.3 million cases of aggravated asthma every year.**

**That’s why McMaster’s massive first quarter fundraising haul means one thing: we need to double down before the end of the month deadline hits if we want to compete.

name: Aadland For Colorado
subject: Lifting Title 42
body:
Making all states border states in one stroke
---
| | | | | | Volume 39 | April 27, 2022
---
|
---
| A word from Erik
---
| | |
---|---
|
Many Americans have become familiar with the term Title 42. It was implemented under existing law and is used to prevent illegal immigrants from entering the United States due to the COVID pandemic.

The Biden administration, under the full control of the radical left in Congress, campaigned on a promise to pull back Title 42 and still wants to do so. The radicals want a flood of illegal border crossers to impale themselves on communities throughout the nation. These illegal immigrants will, by design of Democrats in Congress and many city councils and state houses, become fully dependent on the largesse of local, state, and federal governments --- and evolve into Democrat voters.

In effect, all states are becoming border states.

Removing Title 42 peels away this one small, but effective, measure to prevent overwhelming our hospitals, schools, state-support systems, and federal programs.

This week a federal court judge in Louisiana temporarily blocked the Biden administration's plan to lift the restrictions on border crossings in May.

While this court decision is certainly welcomed, it is only a temporary obstacle. The open borders crowd will not stop until border crossings continue unabated and we must act to stop it all.

Our national border has already become a mere stopover for virtually anyone from anywhere on the way to a town or city near you. Title 42 is not a perfect and permanent solution to preventing illegal entry, but it provides at least some effort aimed at stemming the tide of crossing.

So-called "got-aways"--those that cross the border and escape capture--continue to mount at the same time and lifting Title 42 will result in a massive, almost unabated flow of illegals from countries worldwide. Why stop in one of our airports and show passports or cross at a legal border crossing with authorizing documents in hand?

Look for record numbers of illegal immigrants arriving at our border starting literally minutes after a decision is allowed to come into effect.
| | |
---|---
|
For those of us in Colorado, some will say that since we are not on the border this will have no impact on our cities or support systems. That is a wrong assumption. The federal government is actively transporting illegal immigrants to cities across the nation, often at night, and with little or no coordination with local officials.

None of us are immune to this fact and all of us are paying the price. Again, we are all border states now.

Our current Congress and certainly the Biden administration wants this outcome and is actively seeking to allow as many individuals in as possible. They are counting on this influx to be nestled in safely, unendingly dependent on government programs, and for Democrat politicians, new, loyal constituents.

But there is more to this than simply illegal immigrants coming into the country.

Who other than the illegal immigrants benefit from this administration's anti-American actions? Smuggling cartels. They are enriching themselves through trafficking the illegals who simply want to illegally enter the U.S., but also human trafficking of children and women in the sex trade.
| | |
---|---
|
Another aspect of the cartel's activities is contributing to the huge drug trade, including pushing the drug Fentanyl to our cities leading to the deaths of thousands of mostly young people.

Republican (and some Democrat) leaders from our border states are fully aware of the tsunami that is coming. This is not guesswork. One need only see the preparations being made in central America for mass caravans.

As your Congressman, I will fight to uphold existing immigration laws, extend authorities to tighten our border regulations in favor of the American people, build the wall, and listen to the business and community groups most impacted by illegal immigration to find new ways to reduce the influx.

I will also push hard for more training for border guards, the National Guard, and even states that ask for it, to better control immigration crossing.

Immigration reform is a matter that only Congress can take on and new laws must support our citizens rights to be free from people who are overwhelming our social systems and resources that were designed for American citizens, pumping drugs into our communities, and human trafficking on a massive scale.

We must stop them and the unprecedented corruption in Washington that is allowing this invasion on our southern border.
|

Republican (and some Democrat) leaders from our border states are fully aware of the tsunami that is coming. This is not guesswork. One need only see the preparations being made in central America for mass caravans. As your Congressman, I will fight to uphold existing immigration laws, extend authorities to tighten our border regulations in favor of the American people, build the wall, and listen to the business and community groups most impacted by illegal immigration to find new ways to reduce the influx. I will also push hard for more training for border guards, the National Guard, and even states that ask for it, to better control immigration crossing. Immigration reform is a matter that only Congress can take on and new laws must support our citizens rights to be free from people who are overwhelming our social systems and resources that were designed for American citizens, pumping drugs into our communities, and human trafficking on a massive scale. We must stop them and the unprecedented corruption in Washington that is allowing this invasion on our southern border. | | | | | | | == | | | | Campaign Update | | ---|--- | Yet another busy week (YABW?) for Erik and the Aadland for Congress campaign. Erik joined the South Jeffco Conservative Club members at their monthly meeting to thank them for their overwhelming support at last month's Assembly. He spoke and took questions from the gathering. Dan Caplis (630 KHOW radio) put Erik on the air once again for spirited talk about CD7 and the battle against the radical left. You can hear any of the thirty-plus radio interviews Erik has given this year at the link below | | == | | Neighborhood walking has begun! Every campaign has to do it; hit the pavement, walk the precinct and talk to the neighbors. Erik and about a dozen Aadland for Congress volunteers (AKA the AadSquad) met up near Alameda International Jr/Sr High School in Lakewood on Saturday last. The group spent the next several hours walking the area and knocking on doors. The reaction was overwhelmingly positive and many folks were pleasantly surprised to meet Erik in person at their door, to share his vision of getting our Congressional District back into conservative hands. | | | If you may be interested in an Area Coordinator opportunity with Erik's campaign, use the link below to send your information, or contact: mailto:staff@aadlandforcolorado.com | | | == | | | | Quote of The Week "if it has to be subsidized it's not economically viable" \- Erik Aadland on energy development | A True Grass-Roots Campaign | Erik's effort to represent Colorado is a true grass-roots campaign. subject: Politifact just rated this FALSE
disclaimer_text: paid for and approved by Nikki Fried, Democrat, for Governor
body:
Peter —

A few weeks back, Charlie Crist confirmed something we all suspected — that he still considers himself “pro-life.”

And of course, he’s spent the last few weeks backtracking, claiming that he’s “always” believed in a woman’s right to choose, and basically trying to say he meant live, laugh, love when he said “pro-life.” 🙄

Today, the Tampa Bay Times published an overview of Charlie’s record on abortion rights. And their verdict was the same as ours: when Charlie says he’s “always” believed in a woman’s right to choose, he’s flat-out lying.

The rating? “FALSE”

Charlie’s spent his entire political career flip-flopping on abortion rights whenever it was politically convenient. And with attacks on women’s rights getting worse every day, Florida women deserve a Governor who has NEVER wavered in her support for a woman’s right to choose.

If you agree, click here to rush a $10 donation before our April deadline and help elect a Governor who has ALWAYS fought for women’s rights, abortion rights, and reproductive freedom. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-apr-2022?refcode=eom2crist]

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately.
Express Donate $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-apr-2022?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=eom2crist]

Charlie’s answer on whether he’s pro life is exactly why people hate politics and career politicians like him.

I don’t have to go through verbal gymnastics to defend my record on abortion rights. I’ve been standing up on this issue my entire life.

It’s simple: you either support women or you don’t, and Charlie Crist clearly doesn’t. So, if you support a woman’s right to choose, I’m asking you to chip in $10, support my campaign, and join my fight for women’s rights in Florida before our April deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-apr-2022?refcode=eom2crist]

Thank you for standing with me.

— Nikki

I have no idea why, but I’m definitely guilty of having terrible penmanship – I’ve served in the medical field for over 35 years and my handwriting has never gotten better. | [](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=58cda227d6514621b1c667aeb63c5111&_e=5DyIyCQEqXAiEApOie8i_7bxl6Jn10yzQo-QENsOOXXtHTEcbwpdgydh8JC-hpV58y4B7ZuA3Rl2IRL3_n_bsabzYp1WlR_WrhktfpMAIKLYaB6SloQddnZnyZ46B6C9ST7Ke2c-h3tiHgJG0IfHmVMv_DHf0j1hUeGjGmM0zJYDhvCBnwQt0TDfYjbwnfsBppUeOFAZBLcpA4PmRVM7BgDz5V-qaXpxYnXO00nyY31EI96BIWZ1hxuJrM5vAww90Bm7qzATCS6O0y5UEajNtUXoD-yhP-02ISzOWdH00KGFMxm1PyGiRxtYt_MAw59VeBP9Vvvb0sW1MqMhl_puNB8vSF56dFykaYs2rcYG7GICm9mJanKh4cCnipmEmq51)

Peter,

Why do doctors have such bad handwriting?

I have no idea why, but I’m definitely guilty of having terrible penmanship - I’ve served in the medical field for over 35 years and my handwriting has never gotten better.

_Peter, now that I have your attention_ would you spend a few minutes and read about my story?

I dedicated my life to serving others through the medical field - after I completed my surgical residency in Urology and Renal Transplantation, my wife and I settled in Greenville, NC to start a practice. Outside of my direct work in healthcare, I’ve traveled extensively for the last 35 years to Third World Countries including India, several parts of Africa, Nicaragua, and Haiti as a Medical Missionary.

But Peter, my world got flipped upside down in 2019 when Congressman Walter B Jones, Jr. passed away after serving eastern North Carolinians for more than 22 years, and North Carolina needed someone to step up and serve.

For the past three years, I’ve spent time serving Americans in a new way: **as a U.S. congressman**. It’s not always an easy job, but after working in the medical field, I’ve learned that the most fulfilling jobs rarely are.

It’s been an honor to serve and find new ways to help constituents and all Americans, and I’m grateful for the opportunity to continue to work for you, Peter.

**My ask of you today is simple:** to continue to serve you and your family, and work on the issues that matter to you the most, [**I need your financial support. As a surgeon, there are times when you have to have uncomfortable conversations. This is no different. | | The State of the Campaign - El estado de la campaña
---
| |
---
| | Acabamos de terminar el segundo trimestre de la campaña y tenemos un gran progreso para compartir. La recaudación de fondos para el primer trimestre batió récords, al igual que el segundo. ¡Recaudamos más dinero que cualquier otro retador demócrata en el estado y más dinero que cualquier retador republicano en el distrito cuatro del Congreso! La estructura de esta campaña y nuestro ambicioso plan de comunicación nos ha llevado más lejos, más rápido y con mayor éxito que otras campañas. Mi campaña está organizada para incluir a todos los presidentes de condados demócratas y distritos legislativos. Al hacerlo, aprovechamos de inmediato décadas de conocimiento y vastas redes de relaciones y recursos. Esto nos permitió empezar en un punto al que otras campañas no podían llegar en años, mucho menos en un ciclo electoral. We have just finished the second quarter of the campaign, and we have great progress to share. Fundraising for the first quarter was record breaking, and so was the second. We raised more money than any other democratic challenger in the state and more money than any republican challenger in congressional district four! The structure of this campaign and our ambitious outreach plan has moved us further, faster and with greater success than other campaigns. My campaign is organized to include all of the Democratic County and Legislative District chairs. In doing so we immediately tap into decades of knowledge and vast networks of relationships and resources. This allowed us to start at a point that other campaigns could not reach in years, much less an election cycle.
---
| |
---
|
---
| | Reconocí que el modelo electoral tradicional solo nos llevaría hasta cierto punto. No podemos ignorar la forma en que se hacen las cosas, pero la política tradicional carece de inclusión. Cuando pregunté cómo llegaríamos al 50% o más de mis electores que son hispanos, la respuesta anterior fue: “podemos traducir un volante al español”; eso no es inclusión. Incorporé al primer Defensor de la Diversidad pagado a tiempo completo para llegar a las comunidades que estaban privadas de sus derechos del proceso político y hacerles saber que en esta campaña hay espacio para todos. La respuesta ha sido abrumadoramente positiva. Me he fijado metas altas para esta campaña. Ya he estado desde la parte superior de este distrito hasta el fondo y de regreso 3 veces y cada semana nosotros:
* celebrar un ayuntamiento
* Trabajar para llamar a 50.000 puertas antes de julio
* Banco de teléfono dos veces
* celebrar un evento
* Participar en más de 5 eventos realizados o patrocinados por otras organizaciones
* ¡Y solo estamos empezando!

Comenzaremos a vender letreros de jardín la próxima semana @ [www.DougWhite4Congress.us](https://www.dougwhite4congress.us/so/52O1iUYV4/c?w=uWDljPItcfK1bg9aswSEjnNuRW_psK46bY-PZ1GO1rs.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cDovL2RvdWd3aGl0ZTRjb25ncmVzcy51cyIsInIiOiIyN2ZlNzNlMS1hZjQ4LTQzNjQtOThkOC0yZmQxOWI0NTNhY2QiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIwNDk2ZmZlMC1jMGJhLTQ2MDYtOTk4Ni1jMjgwMzdlOGQxNTUifQ) La campaña también ha estado trabajando para traducir completamente toda nuestra literatura, incluido nuestro sitio web, al español. ¡Asegúrese de visitar el sitio web el 1 de mayo para ver la versión completamente en español, y mientras esté allí, puede reservar su letrero de jardín! La votación también tendrá lugar a finales de mayo. Estamos aumentando nuestros viajes, recaudación de fondos y alcance comunitario, con planes de llegar a tres veces más personas en junio que en abril.
---
| | I recognized that the traditional election model would only get us so far. We cannot ignore the way things are done, but traditional politics lack inclusion. When I asked how we would reach the 50+% of my constituents that are Hispanic the old answer was, “we can translate a flier into Spanish”; that is not inclusion. I brought on board the first full time paid Diversity Advocate to reach out to communities that were disenfranchised from the political process and let them know there is room in this campaign for everyone. The response has been overwhelmingly positive.I have set high goals for this campaign. I have already been from the top of this district to the bottom and back again 3 times already and every week we:
* Hold a Town Hall
* Work towards knocking on 50,000 doors before July
* Phone bank twice
* Hold one event
* Participate in more than 5 events held or sponsored by other organizations
* And we are just getting started!

We will start selling yard signs next week @ [www.DougWhite4Congress.us](https://www.dougwhite4congress.us/so/52O1iUYV4/c?w=rul2JEP65nBr9wo9n1SUl_HsMZipkGgrJf64_FLaOSE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cDovL3d3dy5kb3Vnd2hpdGU0Y29uZ3Jlc3MudXMiLCJyIjoiZTY2MmVlZDYtZWNhMS00MTllLWI1NDItMjFhMTY4OTEwNDUwIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMDQ5NmZmZTAtYzBiYS00NjA2LTk5ODYtYzI4MDM3ZThkMTU1In0) The campaign has also been working to fully translate all of our literature, including our website, into Spanish. Be sure to check out the website on May 1st to see the fully Spanish version, and while you’re there you can reserve your yard sign! Polling will also take place in late May. We are ramping up our travel, fundraising and community outreach, with plans to reach three times as many people in June as we did in April.
---
| |
---
| Doug celebra "el tomar democráticamente" en Goldendale. Doug celebrates "Drinking Democratically" in Goldendale.
---
| |
---
| | Nuestro trabajo por la diversidad también ha crecido. Estamos planeando eventos que incluirán comida y cuidado de niños, para poder llegar a las familias jóvenes. Hemos establecido relaciones con organizaciones locales en varios condados, lo que triplica la cantidad de alcance que podemos lograr. Esto amplifica el trabajo que ya se está haciendo por la justicia social y ambiental. Estamos trabajando de cerca con un grupo de jóvenes latinos locales para continuar expandiendo nuestra red de base en Tri-Cities a través de diarios, medios, radio/podcast y música y arte. Estamos trabajando en estrecha colaboración con los miembros de las tribus Colville y Yakama para establecer una relación duradera con las comunidades indígenas. Esperamos asistir a nuestros primeros pow-wows y otros eventos importantes. Our work towards diversity has also grown. We are planning events that will include food and childcare, so that we can reach out to young families. We have established relationships with local organizations in several counties, which triples the amount of outreach we are able to achieve. This amplifies work already being done for social and environmental justice. We are working closely with a group of local young Latinos to continue to expand our grassroots network in Tri-Cities through journaling, media, radio/podcast and music and art. We are working closely with Colville and Yakama tribe members to establish a long-standing relationship with indigenous communities. We look forward to attending our first pow-wows and other significant events.
---
| |
---
|
---
| | La semana pasada también asistimos al foro de reforma de inmigración y H2A organizado por el caucus agrícola y rural. El programa H2A está lejos de ser perfecto y necesita más responsabilidad y recursos para hacer cumplir las regulaciones. Es bueno estar en discusión entre productores y trabajadores agrícolas a través de UFW. Asistí a la experiencia En Sus Zapatos que busca dar una mirada al interior desde la perspectiva de las víctimas de violencia doméstica. La violencia doméstica es una de las principales causas de violencia en nuestras comunidades y debe abordarse directamente. In the past week we also attended the H2A and Immigration reform forum hosted by the Ag and Rural caucus. The H2A program is far from perfect and it needs more accountability and resources to enforce regulations. It is good to be in discussion between growers and farmworkers via UFW. I attended the In Her Shoes experience aimed at giving an inside look from the perspective of domestic violence victims. Domestic violence is one of the leading causes of violence in our communities, and needs to be directly addressed.
---
| |
---
| | ¡Cómo ganamos! Los fundamentos de esta carrera cambiaron significativamente en los últimos meses, lo que hizo que nuestro camino hacia la victoria fuera más claro. Todos los indicios continúan apuntando a que Dan Newhouse no sobrevivirá a la primaria. Los indicadores incluyen una reprimenda completa por parte de los republicanos estatales y distritales y su recaudación de fondos se ha desplomado. Loren Culp esperaba un impulso a su campaña con el respaldo de Donald Trump, pero eso no produjo ningún dinero. Hasta ahora su única notoriedad ha venido de su inexcusable y grosero comportamiento. El Partido Republicano se dividió cuando los republicanos del distrito le dieron la espalda a Donald Trump y apoyaron a Brad Klippert. Newhouse no tiene garantizados los votos para ganar las primarias. Pero incluso con esa realidad, el resto de los republicanos no pueden actuar juntos para formar una campaña o gestionar la comunicación con los votantes. ¡La mitad de ellos ya están endeudados! Quizás para asegurarme de enfrentarme a Culp en las primarias, que es el mejor escenario para mi victoria, tendría que prestarle algo de dinero y hacer campaña por él. How we win! The fundamentals of this race changed significantly over the last few months making our path to victory clearer. All indications continue to point to Dan Newhouse not surviving the primary. Indicators include a complete rebuke by the state and district republicans and his fundraising has plummeted. Loren Culp expected a boost to his campaign with Donald Trump’s endorsement, but that did not translate into any money. So far his only notoriety has come from his inexcusable and loutish behavior. The GOP split when the district republicans turned their back on Donald Trump and endorsed Brad Klippert. Newhouse isn’t guaranteed the votes to win the primary. But even with that reality, the rest of the republicans can not get their act together to form a campaign or manage outreach. Half of them are in debt already! Perhaps to ensure I will face Culp in the primary, which is the best scenario for my victory, I would have to loan him some money and do some campaigning for him.
---
| |
---
|
---
| | Mi campaña está agradecida por la coalición que estamos construyendo y el trabajo que se está realizando. Espero continuar actualizándolos en nuestro camino hacia la victoria. My campaign is grateful for the coalition we are building, and the work that is getting done. I look forward to continuing to update you on our path to victory.
---

La recaudación de fondos pa | | Can't see this message? | | | | | | The State of the Campaign - El estado de la campaña | | | | Acabamos de terminar el segundo trimestre de la campaña y tenemos un gran progreso para compartir. La recaudación de fondos para el primer trimestre batió récords, al igual que el segundo. ¡Recaudamos más dinero que cualquier otro retador demócrata en el estado y más dinero que cualquier retador republicano en el distrito cuatro del Congreso! La estructura de esta campaña y nuestro ambicioso plan de comunicación nos ha llevado más lejos, más rápido y con mayor éxito que otras campañas. Mi campaña está organizada para incluir a todos los presidentes de condados demócratas y distritos legislativos. Al hacerlo, aprovechamos de inmediato décadas de conocimiento y vastas redes de relaciones y recursos. Esto nos permitió empezar en un punto al que otras campañas no podían llegar en años, mucho menos en un ciclo electoral. We have just finished the second quarter of the campaign, and we have great progress to share. Fundraising for the first quarter was record breaking, and so was the second. We raised more money than any other democratic challenger in the state and more money than any republican challenger in congressional district four! The structure of this campaign and our ambitious outreach plan has moved us further, faster and with greater success than other campaigns. My campaign is organized to include all of the Democratic County and Legislative District chairs. In doing so we immediately tap into decades of knowledge and vast networks of relationships and resources. This allowed us to start at a point that other campaigns could not reach in years, much less an election cycle. | | | | | Reconocí que el modelo electoral tradicional solo nos llevaría hasta cierto punto. No podemos ignorar la forma en que se hacen las cosas, pero la política tradicional carece de inclusión. Cuando pregunté cómo llegaríamos al 50% o más de mis electores que son hispanos, la respuesta anterior fue: “podemos traducir un volante al español”; eso no es inclusión. Incorporé al primer Defensor de la Diversidad pagado a tiempo completo para llegar a las comunidades que estaban privadas de sus derechos del proceso político y hacerles saber que en esta campaña hay espacio para todos. La respuesta ha sido abrumadoramente positiva. Me he fijado metas altas para esta campaña. Ya he estado desde la parte superior de este distrito hasta el fondo y de regreso 3 veces y cada semana nosotros: celebrar un ayuntamiento Trabajar para llamar a 50.000 puertas antes de julio Banco de teléfono dos veces celebrar un evento Participar en más de 5 eventos realizados o patrocinados por otras organizaciones ¡Y solo estamos empezando! Comenzaremos a vender letreros de jardín la próxima semana @ La campaña también ha estado trabajando para traducir completamente toda nuestra literatura, incluido nuestro sitio web, al español. ¡Asegúrese de visitar el sitio web el 1 de mayo para ver la versión completamente en español, y mientras esté allí, puede reservar su letrero de jardín! La votación también tendrá lugar a finales de mayo. Estamos aumentando nuestros viajes, recaudación de fondos y alcance comunitario, con planes de llegar a tres veces más personas en junio que en abril. | | I recognized that the traditional election model would only get us so far. We cannot ignore the way things are done, but traditional politics lack inclusion. When I asked how we would reach the 50+% of my constituents that are Hispanic the old answer was, “we can translate a flier into Spanish”; that is not inclusion. I brought on board the first full time paid Diversity Advocate to reach out to communities that were disenfranchised from the political process and let them know there is room in this campaign for everyone. The response has been overwhelmingly positive.I have set high goals for this campaign. I have already been from the top of this district to the bottom and back again 3 times already and every week we: Hold a Town Hall Work towards knocking on 50,000 doors before July Phone bank twice Hold one event Participate in more than 5 events held or sponsored by other organizations And we are just getting started! We will start selling yard signs next week @ The campaign has also been working to fully translate all of our literature, including our website, into Spanish. Be sure to check out the website on May 1st to see the fully Spanish version, and while you’re there you can reserve your yard sign! Polling will also take place in late May. We are ramping up our travel, fundraising and community outreach, with plans to reach three times as many people in June as we did in April. | | | Doug celebra "el tomar democráticamente" en Goldendale. Doug celebrates "Drinking Democratically" in Goldendale. | | | | Nuestro trabajo por la diversidad también ha crecido. Estamos planeando eventos que incluirán comida y cuidado de niños, para poder llegar a las familias jóvenes. Hemos establecido relaciones con organizaciones locales en varios condados, lo que triplica la cantidad de alcance que podemos lograr. Esto amplifica el trabajo que ya se está haciendo por la justicia social y ambiental. Estamos trabajando de cerca con un grupo de jóvenes latinos locales para continuar expandiendo nuestra red de base en Tri-Cities a través de diarios, medios, radio/podcast y música y arte. Estamos trabajando en estrecha colaboración con los miembros de las tribus Colville y Yakama para establecer una relación duradera con las comunidades indígenas. Esperamos asistir a nuestros primeros pow-wows y otros eventos importantes. Our work towards diversity has also grown. We are planning events that will include food and childcare, so that we can reach out to young families. We have established relationships with local organizations in several counties, which triples the amount of outreach we are able to achieve. This amplifies work already being done for social and environmental justice. We are working closely with a group of local young Latinos to continue to expand our grassroots network in Tri-Cities through journaling, media, radio/podcast and music and art. We are working closely with Colville and Yakama tribe members to establish a long-standing relationship with indigenous communities. We look forward to attending our first pow-wows and other significant events. | | | | | La semana pasada también asistimos al foro de reforma de inmigración y H2A organizado por el caucus agrícola y rural. El programa H2A está lejos de ser perfecto y necesita más responsabilidad y recursos para hacer cumplir las regulaciones. Es bueno estar en discusión entre productores y trabajadores agrícolas a través de UFW. Asistí a la experiencia En Sus Zapatos que busca dar una mirada al interior desde la perspectiva de las víctimas de violencia doméstica. La violencia doméstica es una de las principales causas de violencia en nuestras comunidades y debe abordarse directamente. In the past week we also attended the H2A and Immigration reform forum hosted by the Ag and Rural caucus. The H2A program is far from perfect and it needs more accountability and resources to enforce regulations. It is good to be in discussion between growers and farmworkers via UFW. I attended the In Her Shoes experience aimed at giving an inside look from the perspective of domestic violence victims. Domestic violence is one of the leading causes of violence in our communities, and needs to be directly addressed. | | | | ¡Cómo ganamos! Los fundamentos de esta carrera cambiaron significativamente en los últimos meses, lo que hizo que nuestro camino hacia la victoria fuera más claro. Todos los indicios continúan apuntando a que Dan Newhouse no sobrevivirá a la primaria. Los indicadores incluyen una reprimenda completa por parte de los republicanos estatales y distritales y su recaudación de fondos se ha desplomado. Loren Culp esperaba un impulso a su campaña con el respaldo de Donald Trump, pero eso no produjo ningún dinero. Hasta ahora su única notoriedad ha venido de su inexcusable y grosero comportamiento. El Partido Republicano se dividió cuando los republicanos del distrito le dieron la espalda a Donald Trump y apoyaron a Brad Klippert. Newhouse no tiene garantizados los votos para ganar las primarias. Pero incluso con esa realidad, el resto de los republicanos no pueden actuar juntos para formar una campaña o gestionar la comunicación con los votantes. ¡La mitad de ellos ya están endeudados! Quizás para asegurarme de enfrentarme a Culp en las primarias, que es el mejor escenario para mi victoria, tendría que prestarle algo de dinero y hacer campaña por él. How we win! The fundamentals of this race changed significantly over the last few months making our path to victory clearer. All indications continue to point to Dan Newhouse not surviving the primary. Indicators include a complete rebuke by the state and district republicans and his fundraising has plummeted. Loren Culp expected a boost to his campaign with Donald Trump’s endorsement, but that did not translate into any money. So far his only notoriety has come from his inexcusable and loutish behavior. The GOP split when the district republicans turned their back on Donald Trump and endorsed Brad Klippert. Newhouse isn’t guaranteed the votes to win the primary. But even with that reality, the rest of the republicans can not get their act together to form a campaign or manage outreach. Half of them are in debt already! Perhaps to ensure I will face Culp in the primary, which is the best scenario for my victory, I would have to loan him some money and do some campaigning for him. | | | | | Mi campaña está agradecida por la coalición que estamos construyendo y el trabajo que se está realizando. Espero continuar actualizándolos en nuestro camino hacia la victoria. My campaign is grateful for the coalition we are building, and the work that is getting done. I look forward to continuing to update you on our path to victory. | | | | | | | | Share on social | | | | You've received this email because you are a subscriber of . We set a goal of finding 20,000 conservatives to endorse me by primary day (**next Tuesday**) and we’re coming up short of that number.**I’m not seeing your name on our official endorsement list** and was hoping you’d consider making your personal endorsement of my campaign today. We need just 774 new endorsement's per day over the next week to hit our goal. **[Can I count on you to make yours right now?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=dc900d33a40e49d39ed3bc2e8a1a25d7&_e=z2vDWhEYJnIT3V3id6aH0bYPCT_a-4yg3Fjl5uIublE_W0GfzciytfoqCdFcuLtg7SWKDMB5RZHcoEmpXUK0X9i-wfpy1UFI_zqh-OuMVwaluLY2a6_28ChSIz2o4ZJiek-Sopp3XVW05ksKWUffmhXfwRLqdBF-sWpYvdo7LT7nBAHT7jlWVO10A2flbHZ9v2sGITU5K0GHU8aNN7YtHfiyIJ84CrpGXfCNQYRoHux9RMnpL6QwWkISrHdlcgD-Luci8VChUEqYl7CEcKvSEh_oZokPOKi3QNyXhMUiKFxlilHfGTBpZnBf6_OBEc5aE7RBjbsAZR7vwJ3-YR0F7f3IxtVGn_JQNf27P4b2dpmIGVqyy18VH-nmAQkayZiwHL34dx9nurU57Ian_C0cTtqSBzuVron1hqvUS1fTQMLMYJLPWSV8JTABfq6PjQfomofyBuSj3pIJl8Lqk6Paf5x1ztcQbUj9LGWbVgDVoHU%3D)**

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=dc900d33a40e49d39ed3bc2e8a1a25d7&_e=z2vDWhEYJnIT3V3id6aH0bYPCT_a-4yg3Fjl5uIublE_W0GfzciytfoqCdFcuLtg7SWKDMB5RZHcoEmpXUK0X9i-wfpy1UFI_zqh-OuMVwaluLY2a6_28ChSIz2o4ZJiek-Sopp3XVW05ksKWUffmhXfwRLqdBF-sWpYvdo7LT7nBAHT7jlWVO10A2flbHZ9v2sGITU5K0GHU8aNN7YtHfiyIJ84CrpGXfCNQYRoHux9RMnpL6QwWkISrHdlcgD-Luci8VChUEqYl7CEcKvSEjC43MsDeogqybCjg2NfXkqhdLVufh4WFetYSKlIX2niKeBuzqEawnWdx6ZAd00QcU-vchFSB-p1_aCPZC1g7YPod6mrgWgJz0sZCzzN7s9uJzp2Vn3ywnjXEDQ47rLXMuC75HspW6JvyMyk_tqNIWlpbi1iwoEWgi4OYNPwdRLE8hg54B8sQ0pn8lKWEVUD0CefIX1b5oDoFJ0MNNwleYQ%3D)

Peter,

Six days from today is not only May 3rd (**WOW**), but it also happens to be the Ohio primary elections. Logo

Crypto billionaires have dropped another six figures to stop Team Jane HOPE’s momentum. Can you make a contribution of $30 to our campaign today? Your donation will help us fight back against the huge amounts of Super PAC spending pouring into this race.
Donate Here (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email_ask?utm_source=Jane+Hope+Hamilton+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d85d09d2ae-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_04_22_05_05_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_e512749a93-d85d09d2ae-596842679)

Team Jane HOPE!

Yesterday, news broke that crypto billionaires dropped another $250,000 to flood the airwaves with ads supporting our opponent, Jasmine Crockett. With less than a month away from the primary, it’s clear this is a last-ditch effort to stop our momentum .

Friends, this is concerning. As a North Texas resident for over 20 years, and as someone who is raising their children here, I am concerned about what this means for our neighbors. TX-30 has pressing concerns – underfunded school, a lack of good paying jobs, inaccessible healthcare, the list goes on – yet our communities’ concerns are being drowned out by the needs of billionaires in the Bahamas.

Crypto billionaires have spent a total of $2.5 million to buy this Congressional seat. Crockett recently moved to North Texas, she doesn’t know what our families need. Team Jane HOPE has truly local support. Over 74% of our donors are in-state, we have by far the most precinct chair support, and unlike our opponent we have local labor unions and former CD-30 primary challengers behind us, as well as, trusted North Texas elected officials.

One thing I know for sure, is together we are far more powerful than any billionaire Super PAC donor. With Election Day 27 days away, I need your help to fight back, will you please consider donating $30 today?
Donate Here (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email_ask?utm_source=Jane+Hope+Hamilton+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d85d09d2ae-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_04_22_05_05_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_e512749a93-d85d09d2ae-596842679)

body:
[1]Charles Booker

20, Peter.

Starting today, there’s exactly 20 days left until the primary.

That’s 20 days until we become the official Democratic challenger to
replace Rand Paul.

We plan on spending the next 20 days working harder than ever to grow this
progressive moment and make sure Kentuckians know that Charles is our best
chance to defeat Rand Paul.

But if we want to be ambitious in our work, we need the resources to
match. So today, we’re setting a goal to raise 7,500 grassroots
contributions before the end of the month.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220427?refcode=em20220427-1826&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&refcode2=1826_346206_cVFbNK&akid=1826%2E346206%2EcVFbNK ]It’s critical we reach this big end-of-month goal and make sure we have
the funds we need to get through our primary. Will you chip in $20 or
whatever spare change you have to help out?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220427?refcode=em20220427-1826&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&refcode2=1826_346206_cVFbNK&akid=1826%2E346206%2EcVFbNK ]DONATE NOW →

There’s a lot of work left to do if we want to pull off a grassroots
victory on May 17 and make sure we’re ready to challenge Rand’s
corporate-backed campaign.

Especially in Kentucky, where there’s a long history of voter suppression,
it’s critical we invest as much as we can into our voter outreach and
volunteer programs.

Giving $20 might not seem like it would make a big difference in funding
our operations, but there’s so much power when we put our donations
together.

This movement was built by teachers, coal miners, plumbers, fast-food
workers, students, and believers in change who came together and chipped
in whatever they can afford to show their support. So please don’t ever
doubt how much of a difference your donation can make.

If you want to make Medicare for All, economic justice, and defeating Rand
Paul a reality — it’s critical you give your support now when it really
matters.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220427?refcode=em20220427-1826&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&refcode2=1826_346206_cVFbNK&akid=1826%2E346206%2EcVFbNK ]Will you chip in $20 or anything you can to fund our people-powered
campaign? Every little bit counts as we race to raise 7,500 grass
contributions before the month ends.

Thank you,

Team Booker

Democrat Nikki Budzinski is running for Congress in Illinois' 13th District. This district is currently in Republican hands, and is by far one of the most competitive in the entire country.

Nikki has spent her life fighting for workers and working families by strengthening unions nationwide, and she was instrumental in passing a $15 minimum wage in Illinois while working as a senior advisor for Governor JB Pritzker. Fellow American,

For me, the Senate race in Georgia is personal. _**Herschel and I have a lot in common.**_

We were both born and raised in the South in lower income families that worked hard to make ends meet. We both were taught faith in God and a strong work ethic. And we both did ok in sports. (Well, I did ok in sports. Herschel was a little better than ok.)

Along the way, we both embraced conservative values - personal responsibility, smaller government, the sanctity of life, a free-market economy, and a strong military. And we dared to run for public office as a Republican.

The Radical Left is _really_ concerned about losing the Senate race in Georgia, so they're _really_ coming after Herschel. They are calling him all the nasty names they've called me - just because we don't fit the Left's definition of what a Black candidate should be. I know what it's like because I've been in his shoes.

_**But Herschel won't let the Left push him around.**_

I appreciate how Heschel inspires young people, brings people together from all walks of life, and fights to ensure the American Dream is available for future generations. I hope you'll agree he deserves our support.

**Herschel's race could be the _most expensive Senate race in the country_ this year. He needs our immediate help to ensure he has adequate financial resources to win this race! **

Herschel and I have a lot in common. We were both born and raised in the South in lower income families that worked hard to make ends meet. We both were taught faith in God and a strong work ethic. And we both did ok in sports. (Well, I did ok in sports. Herschel was a little better than ok.) Along the way, we both embraced conservative values - personal responsibility, smaller government, the sanctity of life, a free-market economy, and a strong military. And we dared to run for public office as a Republican. The Radical Left is really concerned about losing the Senate race in Georgia, so they're really coming after Herschel. They are calling him all the nasty names they've called me - just because we don't fit the Left's definition of what a Black candidate should be. I know what it's like because I've been in his shoes. But Herschel won't let the Left push him around. I appreciate how Heschel inspires young people, brings people together from all walks of life, and fights to ensure the American Dream is available for future generations. body:
[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/46?t=1001&akid=3476%2E3611125%2El083Z3 ][IMG]

Folks—This is a long email, but it’s a very important one.

We’re just days away from our primary election, which means that this time
next week we’ll know which GOP opponent I’ll face on the ballot in
November.

There couldn’t be a better time to lay out what we’re doing to win here in
Ohio. [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/11446?t=1011&amount=25&akid=3476%2E3611125%2El083Z3 ]So, I’ve got to ask—will you chip in toward our $150,000
End-of-Month goal ASAP?

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/11446?t=1012&amount=25&akid=3476%2E3611125%2El083Z3 ]Donate

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Working class Ohioans are being forgotten and left behind by an
ineffective Senate that continually filibusters our priorities and
under-delivers. So I promised myself I would be part of the solution,
instead of the problem.

It’s why we launched our Workers First Tour, traveling to all 88 Ohio
counties during the first year of this campaign. I wanted to look as many
folks in the eyes as possible, shake their hands, and let them know I’m
someone they can trust—someone who will advocate for their needs and fight
for their families.

The vast majority of Americans are working harder and longer, making less,
and falling further behind while the wealthy and well-connected receive
handout after handout to pull ahead.

That’s where business-as-usual politics have taken us. And it’s the
direction my millionaire GOP opponents and their billionaire backers want
to keep us in.

But with your support, we can expand our Democratic Senate majority and
give Ohio the most pro-worker delegation in the Senate. We can finally fix
our economy and pass legislation that prioritizes working families over
big corporations and the uber-wealthy.

However, the reality is: We cannot—and will not—win this race and deliver
for hardworking Ohioans without the strongest team of grassroots
supporters this state has ever seen.

Anything less, and we’ll fail to keep up with the billionaire-funded super
PACs and dark-money GOP mega-donors that are pouring everything they have
into buying this open Senate seat.

That’s why we need your support, folks. [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/11446?t=1013&amount=25&akid=3476%2E3611125%2El083Z3 ]And why I'm sending
this email asking if you’d be willing to chip in toward our $150,000
End-of-Month goal before it’s too late.

I don’t want to look back on this race with regrets. So if that means
sending one more email or asking for one more small-dollar donation, we’re
going to do it. Senate control will be decided here in Ohio—so we’ve got
to give this our all.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/11446?t=1014&amount=10&akid=3476%2E3611125%2El083Z3 ]So, folks, if you’re with us, will you chip in $10, $25, or
more right now to help us hit our $150,000 End-of-Month goal? We can
expand our Senate majority and cut workers in on the deal, but only if we
have your support in our campaign’s most critical moment so far.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/11446?t=1015&amount=10&akid=3476%2E3611125%2El083Z3 ]Donate $10 [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/11446?t=1016&amount=25&akid=3476%2E3611125%2El083Z3 ]Donate $25

Thanks for sticking with me,

Tim Ryan

Hey there, Peter.

Another month is coming to a close, and we're going to be pushing hard to get anywhere near our original goal for the month. Truth is, we've had to face reality and adjust our April goal down a bit in the hopes we can make it up in May. Based on our adjusted targets, we must raise another $4,702 by midnight on the 30th. That's a pretty high daily fundraising average for us, but too much is hanging in the balance for us not to give it everything we've got. If you can help me knock out this budget shortage, please pitch in here: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/brent-hennrich-for-washington](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zdG1fUgG8aFKTw4TdAFcV3OYIkIXLeXYGdiD76HGOclWZYG428h3SLdZNmun5o9X5JjvIosEmmMQuXGLaggGkkdnfcEfjPdSPpJYjyDzxbI-t1VcKT-ToKuWypmsaE5LpdCt4Yt9CU2TjLY2SvijqciZQN4PxwG3W4aYBVAYzzf5BPb1ISWquzpKuuss8QDSnWSdqP96JhCwPUty0adHkYsBm2160rNenR5PPb8nW25jILERNkvE8QM4oNXoHfJRGiBWCEp6CsdGzkLzXTL9DtpTsOmI9sw5yZqTvOQcZMPV4ucnuW1MdPp3QJY2Q10VpQEH5faqEypQJdjijk-2T6/3lk/4QmDkH30QlalRmoygjmxVA/h1/HZ7LR_iTgJsfxWsRBg-z9j_e-7Y62n7XGu9n6w5hMc4)** Leading in the polls feels precarious at best. That lead will be gone in a heartbeat if we don't have the resources to build on the name ID we've grown since announcing my candidacy last Spring. It's common knowledge in WA-03 that incumbent Rep. Jaime Herrera Beutler doesn't care about her constituents. If you're in the district, you know the ongoing, not-so-funny joke that perhaps Jaime would care more about us if we were salmon. It's probably why a white nationalist endorsed by Trump named Joe Kent is gaining ground on Herrera Beutler, despite his deplorable views. body:
Last week, the Michigan GOP followed Trump’s lead and endorsed Kristina Karamo to be my opponent for secretary of state. There will be plenty of time to talk about her and her agenda, but what I can say at the outset is that her endorsement is another sign of a disturbing trend in Michigan and national politics.

Radical conspiracy theorists are no longer shouting on the fringes. They are running for, and winning nominations, for positions where they can do serious harm to our democracy. If successful they will institutionalize their conspiracy theories and their hate. We can’t let that happen, not now, not ever.

With the Michigan GOP formally endorsing Karamo they’re acknowledging that they aren’t remotely concerned with campaigning on real issues like the actual work of the Secretary of State’s Office. Rather, they are laser-focused on relitigating the Big Lie.

Friend, in 2020 we made sure Michigan’s election was safe and secure. It was, without question, the most accessible election in the history of our state. From now through November 8th you’re going to hear me speak the truth about what we’ve done and what we will do in the term ahead, which is continuinge to deliver the results Michiganders want, like branch office visits that take 20 minutes or less, if they are needed at all. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=042722]

My office is responsible for a critical network of services that Michiganders rely on every day. Ensuring that these services remain efficient and affordable requires a complex understanding of the duties of theSecretary of State’s Office. It requires competent, customer-service driven leadership that brings people together for the sake of a better Michigan. It doesn’t matter if you consider yourself a republican, democrat, or an independent, when you use one of our kiosks, our online portal, or come into a branch office you want to take care of business and get on with your day. We understand that, and that’s what we are delivering - service!

Friend, the stakes are incredibly high this year. Yet, with the support of the pro-democracy coalition in our state, I know we will be victorious in November. Pitch in today to help support my re-election campaign and let's keep on defending democracy and delivering results for Michigan together! >> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=042722]

clean_body: Last week, the Michigan GOP followed Trump’s lead and endorsed Kristina Karamo to be my opponent for secretary of state. There will be plenty of time to talk about her and her agenda, but what I can say at the outset is that her endorsement is another sign of a disturbing trend in Michigan and national politics. Radical conspiracy theorists are no longer shouting on the fringes. They are running for, and winning nominations, for positions where they can do serious harm to our democracy. If successful they will institutionalize their conspiracy theories and their hate. We can’t let that happen, not now, not ever. With the Michigan GOP formally endorsing Karamo they’re acknowledging that they aren’t remotely concerned with campaigning on real issues like the actual work of the Secretary of State’s Office. Rather, they are laser-focused on relitigating the Big Lie. Friend, in 2020 we made sure Michigan’s election was safe and secure. It was, without question, the most accessible election in the history of our state. From now through November 8th you’re going to hear me speak the truth about what we’ve done and what we will do in the term ahead, which is continuinge to deliver the results Michiganders want, like branch office visits that take 20 minutes or less, if they are needed at all. [] My office is responsible for a critical network of services that Michiganders rely on every day. Ensuring that these services remain efficient and affordable requires a complex understanding of the duties of theSecretary of State’s Office. It requires competent, customer-service driven leadership that brings people together for the sake of a better Michigan. It doesn’t matter if you consider yourself a republican, democrat, or an independent, when you use one of our kiosks, our online portal, or come into a branch office you want to take care of business and get on with your day. We understand that, and that’s what we are delivering - service! Friend, the stakes are incredibly high this year. Yet, with the support of the pro-democracy coalition in our state, I know we will be victorious in November. Pitch in today to help support my re-election campaign and let's keep on defending democracy and delivering results for Michigan together! >> ] Onward, Jocelyn [] This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. subject: Ballots are out: are you ready to vote?
body:

---|---
| | Hey Peter, Ballots are on their way to you right now! Are you ready to vote in the primary? This election, the future is at stake. The IPCC’s most recent report made it clear that we’re running out of time to transition to clean energy and phase out fossil fuels. Summer is right around the corner, bringing back memories of smoky skies, and deadly-high temperatures. We need to elect climate candidates who are going to steer our state in the right direction, and keep Oregon’s clean energy momentum going. Most importantly, we need to elect a strong climate candidate for governor–and that’s Tina Kotek. As former Speaker of the Oregon House, Tina has been behind all of Oregon’s greatest climate victories in the last decade, and she’s ready to lead as governor on day one. OLCV is proud to endorse Tina Kotek for Oregon governor. If you’ve looked through your voter’s pamphlet, you might’ve noticed OLCV endorsements next to candidates’ names. You can also check out all of our endorsements at **olcv.org/2022-primary-endorsements**. There, you’ll find a list of candidates across the state who stand for environmental justice, clean air and water, and climate action. These are the kinds of candidates we need in office, pushing Oregon toward a brighter future. You have until election day, May 17th, to return your ballot by mail (it just has to be postmarked by May 17th, but doesn’t even need a stamp–postage is now prepaid), and until 8pm that day to return it via dropbox (you can [**find a nearby dropbox here**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44629947/342434731/1486974124?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAxZjZjZGVjLTZhYzYtZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=oKslEY8jyDf4FDDMSkOeYF-jqkE8wIMhFE-XUZPiBTA=&emci=943dace4-61c6-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=01f6cdec-6ac6-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)). When you get your ballot, I hope you’ll join me in voting for climate candidates, and voting for a better future. Happy voting,

Lindsey Scholten
Deputy Director, OLCV |

clean_body: | | | | ---|--- | | Hey Peter, Ballots are on their way to you right now! Are you ready to vote in the primary? This election, the future is at stake. The IPCC’s most recent report made it clear that we’re running out of time to transition to clean energy and phase out fossil fuels. Summer is right around the corner, bringing back memories of smoky skies, and deadly-high temperatures. We need to elect climate candidates who are going to steer our state in the right direction, and keep Oregon’s clean energy momentum going. Most importantly, we need to elect a strong climate candidate for governor–and that’s Tina Kotek. As former Speaker of the Oregon House, Tina has been behind all of Oregon’s greatest climate victories in the last decade, and she’s ready to lead as governor on day one. OLCV is proud to endorse Tina Kotek for Oregon governor. If you’ve looked through your voter’s pamphlet, you might’ve noticed OLCV endorsements next to candidates’ names. You can also check out all of our endorsements at olcv.org/2022-primary-endorsements. There, you’ll find a list of candidates across the state who stand for environmental justice, clean air and water, and climate action. These are the kinds of candidates we need in office, pushing Oregon toward a brighter future. subject: What we can learn from the divisions in the MI GOP

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220427&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220427&amount=28]
Team,
We emailed you on Monday about the chaos that came out of the Michigan Republican Party’s nominating convention last weekend. Well, things seem to spin, and the divisions within the party may tell a bigger story about the state of national politics.
Yesterday, an opinion piece by a lifelong political analyst gives a good summary:
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220427&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220427&amount=28]
Longtime conservatives are feeling alienated after their party’s convention, concerned that the organization is too devoted to President Trump, and diving further and further into chaos and extremism. Here’s an excerpt:
“It was the public disintegration of the Michigan Republican Party as a viable political organization.The party today is a chaotic and hopelessly divided outfit without a strategy for exploiting what is expected to be a Red Wave this November.”
But then came more fallout: Last night, one of the more vocal conservative state representatives, one with deep ties to President Trump, was removed from the Republican caucus in the state House. It’s alleged that he broke caucus rules by campaigning against sitting members of the state House, choosing instead to support their Trump-backed primary challengers.
This member of the House, Matt Maddock, also happens to be married to the co-chair of the Michigan Republican Party, Meshawn Maddock. The two have been called the “MAGA Middlemen”, serving as a gateway between state level candidates and an endorsement from President Trump. They are accused of trying to elect more Trump-style Republicans to the state House in order to populate the House with more members who would support Maddock’s bid for Speaker.
So, what does this tell us? Well, the fractures developing in the Michigan Republican Party only seem to be getting worse — and more traditional Republicans are pushing back publicly and privately. Folks across Michigan want to see their representatives focused on issues that impact their pocketbooks and their kids – not on fighting with members of their own party or demonstrating fealty to the former President to try and secure their own elections.

Breaking news, Peter Willis:
**In a 4-3 decision, the New York Court of Appeals just threw out the redrawn congressional maps, likely pushing our state’s primary election from June 28 all the way back to August.**
Melanie said it since January and reiterated today:

_“Gerrymandering is fundamentally bad for our democracy, regardless of what party does it. The current maps represented an extreme gerrymander of NY-03 — one that would have made constituent services more inefficient, more resource-heavy, and more unfair to the people within its borders. This could have been avoided, and this situation will cause further delays and confusion for voters.”_
So, what does this mean for our campaign to elect Melanie to Congress? Well, the additional time between now and the primary means we’ll have to spend A LOT more money to keep campaigning and getting out the vote.

#### **Barrett Calls on Biden Administration to Extend Title 42**
Yesterday, I introduced a Senate Resolution in opposition to the Biden Administration allowing Title 42 to expire. D.C. Democrats have created a crisis on our Southern border and if Title 42 expires it will lead to 18,000 illegal crossing per day.The Biden Administration needs to take border security seriously. When I get to Congress, I will fight for long lasting border security and defend our national sovereignty. subject: The Democratic establishment is doing everything it can to stop us

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, it seems
like every day the Democratic establishment has another Super PAC trying
to stop us.

Just yesterday, Democratic billionaire mega-donor Reid Hoffman dropped
$500,00 into a new Super PAC called Mainstream Democrats PAC aimed solely
at stopping Justice Democrats. The stated goal of the new Super PAC is to
fight against policies and candidates popular with mainstream Democratic
voters in order to defend the corporate status quo. A better name for them
would be: Injustice Democrats.

Did corporate Democrats really need ANOTHER Super PAC to defend the
establishment? AIPAC, DMFI, and Team Blue PAC, three more arms of the
corporate-backed political establishment, are already lined up to spend
MILLIONS against our working-class Justice Democrats Jessica Cisneros,
Summer Lee, Rana Abdelhamid and Kina Collins.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/104106?refcode=em20220427-23073&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=23073%2E1203867%2E8LE3Bx ]If we’re going to win our races and expand the Squad, we need to bring
in a wave of grassroots donations right now.
Peter, can you
donate today to fuel our fight against establishment Super PACs spending
millions to defeat our candidates?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/104106?refcode=em20220427-23073&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=23073%2E1203867%2E8LE3Bx ]Contribute

And it’s not just the Super PACs. Speaker Nancy Pelosi, James Clyburn, and
Steny Hoyer, the three top Democrats in the House, are also throwing their
weight behind defeating Jessica in TX-28 and protecting their corporate
incumbents.

The establishment and their wealthy corporate donors simply want to stop
more bartenders (AOC), nurses (Cori Bush), and principals (Jamaal Bowman)
from entering the Democratic Party in Congress. They want to stop our
movement from defeating long-time incumbents who serve corporate
interests, not the interests of the people.

These Super PACs call Justice Democrats “extremists” and “left-wing
radicals” — it’s horrible fear-mongering, all in an effort to stifle
advocacy for policies we all need from President Biden’s Build Back Better
to Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, abortion rights, canceling student
debt, and much more.

We know this won’t get any easier. That’s why the establishment is
spending more than they ever have to stop progressive House primary
challengers like Jessica, Summer, Rana, and Kina. But we will keep up our
work to elect our slate so they can join the Squad in Congress and
continue delivering results for working people. We’ve already won one race
this year (Greg Casar in TX-35) and we know we can win more primaries with
your help.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/104106?refcode=em20220427-23073&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=23073%2E1203867%2E8LE3Bx ]Now is such a critical time to chip in if you can, with just three
weeks before our next primary. So,
Peter, can you contribute to
Justice Democrats right now and help us win against the big money of the
Democratic establishment?

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1023&akid=23073%2E1203867%2E8LE3Bx ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1024&akid=23073%2E1203867%2E8LE3Bx ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20220427-23073-footer&t=1025&refcode2=23073_1203867_8LE3Bx&akid=23073%2E1203867%2E8LE3Bx

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. body:
| On the campaign trail with Dan, people often ask me why I chose to get involved in this particular race. The answer is simple:

It’s because MAJOR issues like protecting Social Security and Medicare, lowering prescription drug prices, and bringing manufacturing jobs back to America from overseas are all on the ballot in November.

**Whether or not these issues are addressed — or made worse — all comes down to only a few races, and Dan’s is one of them!

Now, even the National Journal just labeled our race as one of the top ones in danger of flipping. We’ve got to be strong and fight back. [Click here to commit to keeping Dan in Congress fighting for us.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44637186/342487668/399374053?amount=15&contactdata=o%2BFQRyFqn3r2BWmob5%2FVbAFvsr5Xry1XRB1g08lIbMXWFOe6Q6%2F1KGcG%2FD%2FFJO%2FtUIbv4zV1S88CaQBNeFI2eltASUQn0%2F9AslU8fTHkU6bbuDbui2Wxg9k3Ky%2BpeTXx915c74sQ%2FF%2Br%2BLIQnGPHvA%3D%3D&refcode2=5e50fe9c-91c6-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&refcode=DK_EM_FR_3MO_220427_2_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZTUwZmU5Yy05MWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pLmx1FgKYmS1cCm-mRuTPYqzJNUedEwSmnwLpYLCA64=)**

We can't just sit on the sidelines and hope for something better in times like this. We need –– and deserve –– a Governor who will: RESTORE the rights of parents in schools. REFUND our depleted police departments. REBUILD our economy in the wake of Sisolak's shutdowns. In less than 50 days, Nevada Republicans will head to the polls to decide who will face Steve Sisolak in November. While Joe Lombardo was endorsing and giving money to Steve Sisolak in 2018, I was fighting for the America First agenda alongside President Trump. Here's why I need your help now more than ever: for every $1 we have, Lombardo's campaign has $12** –– and that money is coming from everywhere BUT Nevada! If everybody reading this pitches in , , or right now, we can close the gap and win on June 14th. I can’t do this without you. Friend, This has been an exciting week for the campaign as the Tazewell County Governor Candidate Forum received extensive media coverage. Five of the six candidates participated. We received tremendous, positive feedback from the audience. You can watch my interview with former state representative Jeanne Ives that was done before the forum by clicking on the picture below.
[](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6n7V33CGJmqAQ3rGt22pI__hmHDsKY9r4KnnSzukSYPilx8MzB9T_Z97qZ61r8gQenhQw_8kFYN3u7MHR0toUzs&e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=april_27_from_the_trail&n=2) We also made another major cable TV and digital buy for our third TV commercial. It will start running again on Thursday. This purchase was made possible by some of our donors who read these weekly updates (you know who you are). What we are about to say next, we've said before, but it is worth repeating. We don't need billionaire backers when we have YOU on our team. Thank you again for your continued support and generosity.
You can watch our 3rd TV commercial by clicking on the picture below. [](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRbW8V69zKS6a1U19XYDo4AM&e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=april_27_from_the_trail&n=3)
You can help more people see this commercial by donating to our campaign. Click [HERE](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/donate?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=april_27_from_the_trail&n=4) to donate. Every donation--no matter how small--helps!

* * *
**Volunteer of the Week** This week's volunteer to highlight is Dianne Duffin. Dianne volunteers as the scheduler for our campaign (you can reach her in that capacity at Dianne@schimpf4illinois.org). She also recently gave up a Saturday morning to staff our table at the Lake County Straw Poll. Thank you, Dianne, for all your dedication and hard work!

****[If you'd like to volunteer on our campaign, click here.](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/volunteer?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=april_27_from_the_trail&n=5)
* * *
**Upcoming Events** We have multiple upcoming events where you can ask us questions and help give Illinois "A New Start." The full list of events can be found on our campaign website by clicking [HERE](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/events?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=april_27_from_the_trail&n=6). This week we are showcasing one southern and one northern event where you can support us. You can purchase tickets for both these events at the campaign website.
On May 9th, Paul will be at a backyard BBQ in Nashville, Illinois. Tickets are $50 a person or $75 per couple. On May 12th, both Paul & Carolyn will attend a McHenry County reception that focuses on Carolyn's vision for Illinois and the role of the Lieutenant Governor. Tickets are $40 per person.

* * *
**Issue Discussion: Curriculum Transparency
** Parents, not the government, should make the decisions about their children's education. But parents need information in order to make those decisions. That's why one of the proposals in our "New Start for Illinois" policy agenda is curriculum transparency.
As your Illinois Governor, I will have the power to make this change by myself, without having to work with the legislature. I intend to have the Illinois State Board of Education issue a rule that predicates P-12 education funding on curriculum transparency. This means that school districts will have to ensure that parents can view their children's course material in order to be eligible for state funding.
Once again, thank you for reading this e-blast. We look forward to seeing you on the campaign trail.
Paul

name: Sarah Godlewski for U.S. Senate
subject: A difficult decision
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sarah for Wisconsin
body:
I made a difficult decision a few weeks ago that I wanted to follow up on. Hey team, it's Jake — Sarah's campaign manager. I made a difficult decision a few weeks ago that I wanted to follow up with you on personally.

It was during a meeting where it became evident that with Republican spending ramping up and Ron Johnson already running his own TV ads, we would need to fight back earlier than expected.

So I saw an opportunity to make a big investment that would pay off long-term, and we launched our first TV ads as part of a seven-figure buy in every major market across Wisconsin. The money wasn’t in the budget, but I approved the plan anyway.

It was a risky move, but moments ago, a new poll was released of our race for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin, and it shows that everything we’re doing on TV, online, and on the ground is working. We only just started communicating with voters, and Sarah grew the most out of anyone in the primary field — more than doubling her previous numbers.

This race has tightened significantly and our campaign is making all the right moves to win. In fact, thanks to so many of you, we just had our best fundraising quarter to date!

As we celebrate the good news, we also need to keep our foot on the gas and continue getting Sarah’s message out to undecided voters. This poll proves that once folks get to know Sarah and what she stands for, they line up to support her — just like we said they would. But going up on TV and staying up requires a LOT of resources.

I first gave the green light because I knew that if we asked, folks like you would help us fill the significant gap created in our budget — and you did. Now, I’m really hoping we can count on you again to make sure we have the resources to win this Senate race.

**So, what do you say? Would you consider making a contribution to Sarah's campaign so she can compete with Ron Johnson and the GOP? I’m counting on our top supporters — you! — to help get our message in front of as many undecided voters as possible. I made a difficult decision a few weeks ago that I wanted to follow up with you on personally. It was during a meeting where it became evident that with Republican spending ramping up and Ron Johnson already running his own TV ads, we would need to fight back earlier than expected. So I saw an opportunity to make a big investment that would pay off long-term, and we launched our first TV ads as part of a seven-figure buy in every major market across Wisconsin. The money wasn’t in the budget, but I approved the plan anyway. It was a risky move, but moments ago, a new poll was released of our race for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin, and it shows that everything we’re doing on TV, online, and on the ground is working. We only just started communicating with voters, and Sarah grew the most out of anyone in the primary field — more than doubling her previous numbers. This race has tightened significantly and our campaign is making all the right moves to win. In fact, thanks to so many of you, we just had our best fundraising quarter to date! As we celebrate the good news, we also need to keep our foot on the gas and continue getting Sarah’s message out to undecided voters. This poll proves that once folks get to know Sarah and what she stands for, they line up to support her — just like we said they would. But going up on TV and staying up requires a LOT of resources. I first gave the green light because I knew that if we asked, folks like you would help us fill the significant gap created in our budget — and you did. | | **OP-ED ALERT! 🚨**

Today the Delaware Valley Journal published our latest Op-Ed titled, "Dean Cannot Distract Voters from Madeleinflation."

**Democratic leadership is failing America and desperate liberals like Madeleine Dean have already reduced their candidacies to inarticulate insults and shameful political theater.** On a recent Saturday night during a cable news broadcast, Congresswoman Dean (D-Montgomery) said that Republicans, “have no agenda, they’re simply the mouths of a cult.” _**I’m a Republican. Here are three points of my agenda**_ : 1\. Normalize interest rates a year ago when the Covid-driven economic emergency was over. 2\. Stop extending the moratorium on student loan repayment and SBA loans. 3\. Don’t be a cheap politician on cable news. Voters deserve better. Of course, we’ve seen this type of divisive rhetoric before from ultra-wealthy, far-left politicians like Dean who have few accomplishments to show to voters and unlimited amounts of time to spend pandering to their radical friends on cable news programs. It’s nothing new. And that’s the problem.

**Please take a moment to read the full story by clicking on the image below!**
[](https://cn4pa.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2d1d8e72981035507cd4628e7&id=3d26e23123&e=0a4d873a55)

**Unfortunately, that’s all that liberals like Dean have to offer.**
[](https://cn4pa.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2d1d8e72981035507cd4628e7&id=0ceac3b013&e=0a4d873a55) Let’s take back Pennsylvania AND our nation!

Thank you for your friendship and your support,

Christian Nascimento
Republican Candidate for Congress, Pennsylvania

For some perspective, here is what you DO need an ID for:
* To purchase alcohol
* To purchase cigarettes
* To rent or buy a house
* To travel on a plane
* To rent a hotel room
* To get a hunting or a fishing license
* To file for food stamps

clean_body: You can still vote with no ID Fellow Minnesotan, Can you believe that here in Minnesota you can vote without having to show an ID? For some perspective, here is what you DO need an ID for: To purchase alcohol To purchase cigarettes To rent or buy a house To travel on a plane To rent a hotel room To get a hunting or a fishing license To file for food stamps The list goes ON and ON, but ** We need voter ID laws NOW if we are going to secure our elections in Minnesota. Thank you, Senator Paul Gazelka Candidate for Governor | | | ---|---|--- Paid for and Provided by Gazelka for Governor P.O. Box 175 Little Falls, MN 56345

body:
Webster is trying to purchase support from the NRCC, because deep down inside his heart, he knows he doesn't' have enough support in his home district, Florida 11, to get reelected.
