[](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/XaSUTf9BD2wfIvV2Ut8BWQ/fIlYh9zGGu7l8dsRsfzqqw)A few weeks after I met Kevin McCarthy at the National Republican Congressional Committee (NRCC) Donor Retreat in Florida, my RINO opponent, Do-Nothing Dan Webster, shot $20,000 over to the NRCC from his campaign account.

That's right, the same NRCC led by Kevin McCarthy who was just caught on secret audio talking about how he wanted President Trump to resign and go to prison after January 6, 2021!

**That was nearly HALF of what Webster raised for the ENTIRE quarter!**

Back in October of last year, Webster sent the NRCC five grand as his "pittance" to the Establishment Gods.

Webster is trying to purchase support from the NRCC, because deep down inside his heart, he knows he doesn't have enough support in his home district, Florida 11, to get reelected.

But, the NRCC can't save him. Sure, they can have big donors fund him and use Super PAC's to help Webster with a flood of cash . . . but the voters on the ground in my district whom I've met know the truth: Dan Webster is no longer fit to serve!

**The momentum is in my favor, I just have to keep meeting a lot of voters.**

[Help me reach more Republican voters and increase my Name ID in the district by backing my campaign today with a donation of $25 or more.](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/XaSUTf9BD2wfIvV2Ut8BWQ/fIlYh9zGGu7l8dsRsfzqqw)

This race will be won with boots on the ground, a**nd it will be a non-stop march until Primary Day.**

[Please help me fund my ground game by donating today.](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/XaSUTf9BD2wfIvV2Ut8BWQ/fIlYh9zGGu7l8dsRsfzqqw)

Most campaigns don't have to sweat minor costs like filling gas tanks or covering parking. But, I'm running this campaign lean, and taking advantage of every dollar that generously comes in to support my race.

Every dollar counts, and I have to raise another $12,500 by the end of the month to make sure we're on track.

[Will you please help today?](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/XaSUTf9BD2wfIvV2Ut8BWQ/fIlYh9zGGu7l8dsRsfzqqw)

I think if Fox News doesn’t like it, that means I’m onto something! In fact, a CBS News article just today said that “American families need to earn $35.80 an hour just to make ends meet.” = Clearly, $30 should be the floor. Economists from California State University have looked at the historical data and concluded that increasing the minimum wage in the past has not caused inflation or unemployment, contrary to what rightwing corporatist propaganda says. Increasing the minimum wage would be a win-win for the economy and for workers. I was the first Congressional candidate in the country to call for a $30 minimum wage, and the news is already picking it up. I’m leading on this issue, and I need your help to keep that going. Morgan Harper HQ

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

There are now only 19 days left until the Kentucky primary. Here at Team
Booker, we’re working hard to make sure that we are reaching every voter
possible before the big day comes.

A critical part of our voter outreach strategy is hosting phone banks. We
are talking to people about issues that are important to them, collecting
powerful stories, and building upon our collective vision for the future
of Kentucky.

In 2020, we saw historic grassroots victories happen across the South
because campaigns invested in direct voter outreach like phone banks. We
know it’s going to be a critical part of our work to win our primary and
replace Rand Paul.

It costs $5 to reach 100 voters on the dialer.
[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220427-2?refcode=em20220427-2-1827&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&refcode2=1827_346206_KfxPsO&akid=1827%2E346206%2EKfxPsO ]Peter, will
you sponsor a phone bank by chipping in $5 today? Your support will help
fund our phone banks and voter outreach efforts during this important
time.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220427-2?refcode=em20220427-2-1827&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&refcode2=1827_346206_KfxPsO&akid=1827%2E346206%2EKfxPsO ]Sponsor a phone bank →

While calling voters isn’t the only way we’re trying to reach them, it is
one of the most personal, important, and effective ways we can connect
with them.

The grassroots movement we’re building here in Kentucky is proof that we
can win. But it’s going to take all of us working together to contact as
many voters across the Commonwealth.

That requires a lot of resources, supplies, and funding to pull off — and
unlike Rand Paul, Charles Booker doesn't have billionaire donors or
superPACs to fund her. But we have something better: you and the rest of
our grassroots supporters.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220427-2?refcode=em20220427-2-1827&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&refcode2=1827_346206_KfxPsO&akid=1827%2E346206%2EKfxPsO ]Peter,

body:
This is what makes us different.
#
Derek, I wanted to make sure you saw this article about João. 💕
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220427-2?refcode=em20220427-5564&refcode2=5564_434096_bJQEZ6&akid=5564%2E434096%2EbJQEZ6)
Basically, it talks about how our campaign is so fundamentally different from the others.
What makes us so different?
**No icky, dirty money here, thanks very much! 🙅🏻♀️**
We're running a clean and honest Democratic campaign. That means our campaign will never accept dirty corporate PAC money. No shady super PACs. No million-dollar Wall Street checks. And definitely no money from Big Oil.
We fund our campaign this way because we believe it’s the only right way. Because when we say we're people-powered, we really mean it.
Derek, my family and I are just so deeply grateful for all of this, and it’s why I’m asking today:
**[Can you please make your first donation right now to help us raise $100,000 before tonight’s deadline? This is our last FEC deadline before the primary and we need our fundraising numbers to reflect the strength of our grassroots movement.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220427-2?refcode=em20220427-5564&refcode2=5564_434096_bJQEZ6&akid=5564%2E434096%2EbJQEZ6)**
**[Rush $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220427-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220427-5564&refcode2=5564_434096_bJQEZ6&akid=5564%2E434096%2EbJQEZ6)**
And if you can’t donate, remember that even just reading this email makes you a part of this team! Sharing us with your family, friends and uncle Jimmy you haven’t spoken to in a while ... it’s all appreciated so!
We hope being a part of this campaign makes you proud.
With love,
Gisele ❤️
Gisele Barreto Fetterman
Second Lady of Pennsylvania (SLoP)

Our last chance to ramp up our fundraising before voters hit the polls.
#
Early voting starts tomorrow and it’s crunch time. That’s why we’ll get straight to the point: [**_Can you chip in anything you can to help fuel our campaign to the primary election?_**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/50887?t=1&akid=1130%2E3698%2EBX8sse)
**[Donate $5](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/50893?refcode=em20220427-1130&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=1130%2E3698%2EBX8sse)**
**Here’s a little bit about why this election is so important 👇**
**1️⃣** We’re up against Sandy Smith, an insurrectionist and Trumpist who calls Erica a “communist” for her commitment to progressive policies that will support and uplift working people in North Carolina and beyond.
**2️⃣** Super PACs are funneling hundreds of thousands into the race to support our anti-choice, anti-voting rights, conservative Democratic opponent Don Davis.
**3️⃣** Democratic candidates around the country are facing dismal approval ratings due to a few moderates who are blocking progress. Our razor-thin Democratic majority is hanging by a thread — no exaggeration. **We can’t afford to lose even one seat.**
**4️⃣** CNN, Cook Political Report, and many more organizations have ranked the NC-01 race as a critical race that will decide how Congress looks and whether we can achieve long overdue progress.
So, what do you say? [**_Can you chip in $5 or anything you can before voters hit the polls tomorrow? This is the last bit of time we have left to reach out to communities before voting starts._**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/50887?t=21&akid=1130%2E3698%2EBX8sse)
Every dollar we receive will have an immediate impact on the state of our race.
Thank you for everything,
Erica Smith HQ
Erica Smith is a single mother, educator, and three-term state senator, who grew up on her family farm and spent her life fighting for rural Eastern North Carolina. Now, she’s running to represent NC-01 — _her home district_ – in Congress, where she’ll fight for economic justice and workers’ rights, universal healthcare, voting rights, and more. **[Add a donation to help us protect this competitive, open U.S. House seat and give power back to working people »](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/50893?refcode=em20220427-1130-box&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=1130%2E3698%2EBX8sse)** **[Donate](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/50893?refcode=em20220427-1130-box&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=1130%2E3698%2EBX8sse)**
